sectors.sector_verification_note: Sector 1 contains ZERO Tier A professions — nothing in computing is statutorily licensed in India. Almost every record is Tier C judgment. The only verified facts here are the JEE/class-12 subject gates, from data/verified_facts.json.

Unlike Sector 1, this sector has real Tier A licensing — DGCA for pilots and aircraft engineers, DG Shipping for marine engineers, Council of Architecture for architects. Class 12 subject gates and ITI entry rules are Tier B verified. Salary bands remain judgment throughout; India has no authoritative free source for them. NOTE: the AMIE / Institution of Engineers route named in the brief is deliberately EXCLUDED from every path_to_entry — recognition for post-2013 enrolments is unresolved in the Delhi High Court and it is not safe to recommend. Source: data/verified_facts.json#amie-iei-recognition.

Two verified facts shape this whole sector. First, the runway is FUNDED — CSIR JRF pays Rs 37,000/month rising to Rs 42,000 as SRF, so a nine-year path to a research post costs little in fees. Second, under UGC/NEP rules a four-year UG at 75 percent now allows DIRECT PhD entry, skipping the master's entirely. Salary bands remain judgment; India has no authoritative source for scientist pay outside government scales.

The most heavily Tier A sector in the taxonomy — the mirror image of Sector 1, where nothing is licensed. 18 of 20 professions name a statutory licensing body. Two verified facts shape everything: NEET applies equally to government, private AND deemed colleges, so there is NO private bypass for medicine; and the NCAHP Act 2021 moved allied health from unregulated to statutorily licensed, making physiotherapy, optometry, MLT and the imaging and OT technologist roles Tier A rather than open-market.

TIER C BY NATURE, like Sector 1. Nothing in Indian general management is statutorily licensed — no council controls who may call themselves a marketer, an HR professional or a consultant. The one Tier B fact that governs the sector is CAT eligibility, and it is the most OPEN gate in the taxonomy: any three-year degree in any subject, 50 percent, no age limit, no attempt cap. That is why almost every record here is class12_prerequisite 'any' and mid_stream_entry 'after_any_degree'. This is the sector a student who took a wrong turn elsewhere can still reach.

SPLIT TIER. The statutory half is real — ICAI governs Chartered Accountancy and its route was verified — but most of the sector is open market: nobody licenses a financial analyst, a banker or a wealth manager's employer. SEBI and IRDAI impose REGISTRATION on advisers and surveyors, which is a lighter thing than a licence to practise a profession. The Actuary record is deliberately left Tier B judgment rather than asserting IAI's statutory status unverified.

THE MOST STRUCTURALLY PROTECTED SECTOR IN THE TAXONOMY. Six of eight professions carry legal_accountability true — a person signs, and answers for it personally. Three name statutory licensing bodies (Bar Council of India, ICSI) and three more are entered only through state examinations. The single exception, Paralegal, is both the only unlicensed record and by far the most AI-exposed one, which is the sector's own argument about what licensing protects.

TIER C BY NATURE, for the same structural reason as Sector 1: nothing in Indian design is licensed. The Architects Act 1972 protects the title 'architect' and stops there - no statute registers an interior designer, a graphic designer, a product designer, an animator or a fashion designer, and none of them can be struck off. What DOES exist is a set of degree-granting institutes - NIFT under the NIFT Act 2006, NID, the IITs through UCEED, FDDI under the FDDI Act 2017 - which control who gets a qualification but not who may practise. Every profession here is therefore Tier C on entry, and the two Tier B facts in the sector are about institutes, not licences. ECONOMICS ARE JUDGMENT THROUGHOUT except Handloom Weaver, which is the one record in this sector standing on a government earnings survey - and it is a subsistence one.

TIER C THROUGHOUT, and unusually well evidenced for it. Nothing in Indian media is licensed: the Press Council of India is statutory but regulates newspapers' CONDUCT rather than journalists' right to practise, and it cannot strike anyone off. PIB accreditation is routinely mistaken for a licence and is only access to government premises. Against that, this sector holds something no other unlicensed sector has - a STATUTORY PAY SCHEDULE. The Majithia Wage Board, notified in 2011 and upheld by the Supreme Court in 2014, fixes basic pay for working journalists by class of newspaper. It anchors one economics block properly and carries two limits that matter: the figures have never been revised, and the Act covers newspapers only, not television or digital.

TIER C THROUGHOUT, and this sector tests the schema harder than any before it. Nothing is licensed: the Sangeet Natak Akademi is the apex body and it promotes, funds and honours rather than registers, and Akashvani's artist grading is a voluntary broadcast credential that bars nobody from performing. Two Tier B facts were fetched and both describe bodies that do NOT control entry. The real problem here is not verification but FORMAT: eight of nine professions have essentially no employed version in India, so mid_career_lpa - which is employed-only by design - describes almost nobody. Six of nine carry a required admin_review for that reason, which is the highest proportion in the dataset and is a deliberate signal rather than an oversight.

TIER C THROUGHOUT, and this sector makes a point worth generalising: NEW STATUTE DOES NOT MEAN NEW CREDENTIALING. The National Sports Governance Act 2025 is the most significant Indian sports legislation in decades and it regulates federations, tribunals and elections - it licenses no coach, no official and no athlete. Federation coaching and officiating licences are real gates but they are contractual, imposed by employers and competitions rather than by law. The sector's decisive fact is economic rather than regulatory: for most Indian athletes the income from sport is a 7th CPC government salary obtained THROUGH sport via the sports quota, not prize money or a contract.

THE BEST-EVIDENCED SECTOR SINCE HEALTHCARE, and the first outside it with a statutory PAY anchor. Three of four sector facts carry money or law directly: the 7th CPC pay for Kendriya Vidyalaya teachers, the Anganwadi honorarium, and the Rehabilitation Council of India Act 1992 read from the Act itself. Tier placement is mixed by design - Special Educator is genuinely Tier A under RCI registration, School Teacher and College Teacher are Tier B behind TET and UGC NET, and the rest are Tier C. The sector's defining economic fact is that the SAME JOB is paid three completely different ways depending on employer: a Kendriya Vidyalaya primary teacher starts near 8.3 lakh a year, a state government teacher earns less, and a private school teacher in a small town may earn a fifth of it.

A SPLIT SECTOR, and the split is the point. Two professions are Tier A under the Rehabilitation Council of India Act 1992 - Clinical Psychologist here, Special Educator in Sector 12 - where practising unregistered is a criminal offence. Everything beside them is Tier C and entirely unregulated, including the profession that most resembles the licensed one: the titles 'counsellor' and 'psychotherapist' carry NO statutory register in India, and a family paying for therapy cannot tell the two apart from a job title. That is recorded as the sector's central fact rather than smoothed over. Economically this sector shares Sector 10's problem in a different form: employment follows grant cycles, CSR compliance and scheme budgets rather than need, so posts appear and vanish on two-to-three-year project timelines.

TIER C THROUGHOUT, with two gates that are not licences but behave like them. NABET/QCI accreditation decides who may SIGN an Environmental Impact Assessment report - an empanelment created by the clearance process rather than by any professions statute - and the UPSC Indian Forest Service examination controls entry to a 150-post cadre with statutory powers. Two verified facts anchor the sector at opposite ends of it: SEBI's BRSR mandate, which is the regulation that turned corporate sustainability into a job with a deadline, and the NAMASTE scheme and the Manual Scavengers Act, which document a base layer the law abolished and that still employs roughly a lakh people in urban India. This sector contains both the most fashionable white-collar profession in the dataset and its most dangerous manual one.

TIER C THROUGHOUT - nothing in Indian farming is licensed, and the only statutory register adjacent to this sector is veterinary, which is Sector 4. What this sector has instead is the BEST GOVERNMENT DATA in the dataset. The NSS 77th round Situation Assessment Survey gives an agricultural household's monthly income decomposed by source, and the decomposition carries the sector's central finding: since 2019 Indian farming households have earned more from WAGES than from cultivation. A second verified fact corrects a common misunderstanding - the ICAR national entrance fills only 15 percent of bachelor's seats at agricultural universities, so the famous exam is not the ordinary door. Six of eight professions here are self-employment at their core, which puts this sector with 10 and 11 in straining the employed-only salary format.

MOSTLY TIER C WITH ONE HARD TIER A. Merchant Navy Deck Officer sits under the Directorate General of Shipping exactly as Marine Engineer does in Sector 2 - a Certificate of Competency issued after a statutory examination, without which serving is unlawful. Everything else in this sector is unlicensed: nothing registers a chef, a housekeeper, a hotel manager or an event planner, and the only other credential is a Ministry of Tourism guide licence tied to specific monuments. The sector's structural feature is that it is unusually OPEN - NCHMCT JEE offers over 12,000 seats, and three of eight professions are entered with no qualification at all - and unusually dependent on an OVERSEAS pathway, which is where much of the real income in cooking, service and seafaring actually is and which no field here captures.

TIER C THROUGHOUT EXCEPT ARCHAEOLOGY, and even there the regulation is of an ACTIVITY rather than of practitioners: the AMASR Act 1958 regulates archaeological excavation, but no council registers archaeologists and survey, museum and teaching work needs no authorisation. That fact was written deliberately narrowly - the India Code and ASI primary texts returned 403 and were not opened, so no section numbers or penalties are stated, because stating unopened statutory detail is the NCAHP error recorded in DECISIONS.md 10. The sector's structural feature is a consistent mismatch between NEED and FUNDED POSTS: India holds several million uncatalogued manuscripts, a vast quantity of deteriorating material and an enormous archaeological record, and trains a handful of people a year to work on any of it. Seven of eight professions carry demand_signal 'low', which is the highest concentration in the dataset and is a statement about budgets, not about need.

THE MOST UNREGULATED SECTOR IN THE DATASET, and it is the one where that matters most to a member of the public. Every profession here puts a practitioner's hands on a stranger's body - cutting, waxing, bleaching, massaging, tattooing, piercing, washing and lifting - and NOTHING registers any of them. There is one structured credential, the Yoga Certification Board's laddered scheme under the Ministry of AYUSH, and even that is voluntary: no statute bars an uncertified person from teaching yoga. The sector is also the dataset's clearest concentration of work that is physically safe from AI and economically precarious: six of eight professions sit at exposure 20 or below, and five carry a required admin_review because the employed figure describes a salaried floor while the profession's real income is independent, seasonal and unsourced.

Automobile engineering is folded in here. It shares the same skill set as mechanical engineering — thermodynamics, mechanics, CAD, materials, manufacturing — and differs only by industry. Two professions with the same skill profile would always surface together in a psychometric recommender, adding noise without information. Students drawn to vehicles should find this through the automotive industrial tag and the vehicle job roles.

This record carries the CROSS-CUTTING engineering roles - analysis and simulation, manufacturing, prototyping, R&D, project, commissioning and interface engineering - because they exist inside every discipline and a mechanical degree is the most common route into them. They are listed once here rather than repeated on Civil, Chemical, Electrical and the rest, which would duplicate a job role across professions and is rejected by audit.py. A student reading Civil Engineer should understand that Design, Quality and Project roles exist there too.

A B.Tech Marine Engineering degree from a DG Shipping approved institute leads to the MEO Class IV Certificate of Competency, which requires a minimum of 183 days at sea including six months of engine-room watchkeeping on a vessel of at least 750 kW propulsion power, under a qualified engineer officer. The band looks high against shore engineering and the comparison is not like for like. Settled in Engineering & Making rather than Design & Creative Arts. Architecture is more than design: it is licensed, load-bearing and legally accountable for whether a building stands. The CoA Minimum Standards of Architectural Education Regulations 2020 require class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics at 45% aggregate in PCM, plus NATA or JEE Main Paper 2A; the only alternative is a 10+3 diploma with Mathematics. self_employment.route: Own processing or job-work unit, or sourcing consultancy for buyers.

ai_exposure.reason: Mill work is physical and process-bound — spinning, weaving and dyeing happen on machines, not screens. Production planning is partly exposed; diagnosing why a batch dyed unevenly is not.

nuances.statement: Textile ENGINEERING sits here — fibre science, machinery, dyeing chemistry. Apparel and fashion PRODUCTION sits in Sector 8 as craft. The same split as Architect here versus Interior Designer in Sector 8.

Do not read the size of the industry as the size of the profession. deviating_roles.why: Hospital clinical engineering is done beside clinicians and patients, under their pressure and vocabulary. Device design in the same profession is a solitary, spatial engineering job.

The service and calibration roles are hands-on physical work on a machine that is down and must be fixed today - the reward is care and steadiness, not invention. Device design at the other end of the same profession is solitary, spatial and open-ended. This is the widest internal split in Sector 2 and it is also a split in ENTRY: the service roles are reachable on a diploma, the design roles are not.

demand_signal.note: One labour market, two ends. DESIGN work is thin because India imports most of its medical devices. INSTALLATION, calibration, service, regulatory and procurement work is large and durable precisely BECAUSE the design happens elsewhere - every imported machine needs someone here to commission and maintain it. ai_exposure.reason: Devices are physical and safety-critical, and hospital clinical engineering means hands on equipment people's lives depend on. Design documentation is exposed; commissioning an MRI is not.

nuances.statement: Tagged undergrad because that is the DESTINATION for design, regulatory and clinical engineering work. It is not a door. The service and calibration half of this profession is genuinely reachable on a two-year diploma, and a diploma holder converges on the same mid-career band - which is why Biomedical Equipment Technician is a job role here rather than a profession of its own.

Biomedical Equipment Technician was a separate profession until it failed the merge test: same object of concern, same industry, and the two records had written the SAME demand sentence from opposite ends, with an identical mid-career midpoint of 7 lakh. It differed only in entry route, and entry route is not a skill set. Folded in as job roles, with the split recorded in role_spread.

The NCAHP Act's ninth category, Medical Technologists and Physician Associate, names Biomedical Engineer as a covered title. That Act regulates allied health PRACTICE inside Indian clinical care; it does not gate device design, manufacture or field service, so no licensing body is named here.

nuances.statement: Deliberately broader than 'Semiconductor Fab Technician'. A coverage probe found no existing profession covering cleanroom process work, but naming it after semiconductors alone would bet the record on one emerging industry. Pharma cleanroom operation is the same skill set and employs large numbers in India today.

The salary band is shipped at its current level and rests in part on the India Semiconductor Mission delivering operational fabs at scale. path_to_entry.requirement: Physics and Maths compulsory
JEE Main, or a state or private engineering entrance
B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Electronics, Metallurgy or Nuclear — or M.Sc Physics/Chemistry
Clear GATE — this is the real gate into the Department of Atomic Energy
One-year BARC Training School course via OCES or DGFS, then appointment as Scientific Officer

entrance_exams.note: GATE is the decisive exam. BARC screens on a GATE score from any of the last three years.

bypass: 3-year engineering diploma, then lateral entry into B.Tech year 2

demand_signal.note: India's nuclear capacity expansion and the opening of the sector to private participation are growing this, but absolute headcount stays small and concentrated in DAE units.

ai_exposure.reason: Among the most consequence-heavy engineering work there is — a licensed, accountable human is required at every safety decision. Simulation is exposed; deciding whether a reactor is safe to restart is not.

nuances.statement: You do NOT need a nuclear engineering degree. BARC recruits from Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Electronics, Metallurgy, Physics and Chemistry — GATE is the real gate, not the branch name. An M.Sc Physics graduate can enter OCES without any B.Tech at all.

The band is shipped as it stands and reflects central government Scientific Officer pay scales. Those carry allowances, subsidised housing and pension terms that do not appear in a CTC figure, so comparison with a private-sector offer of the same number understates the government package.

professions.one_liner: Decides how a city or region grows - land use, zoning, transport, and what may be built.

deviating_roles.why: Transport and spatial analysis is modelling - travel demand, network capacity, population projection - done in software against datasets. It is the quantitative end and it transfers directly to GIS and data work outside planning.

Development control is applying a statutory master plan to a specific application, refusing some, and being argued with by developers and politicians. It is a municipal post with real authority and real pressure, and it is where most planning graduates actually work.
Urban design works at the scale of a street or a precinct - how a place feels to walk through. It sits between planning and architecture and is the most visual role here.

path_to_entry.requirement: Mathematics. Physics and Chemistry are NOT required for B.Planning - this is one of the few built-environment routes open to a student without a full science stream.
JEE Main Paper 2B (B.Planning), or a state or institutional entrance.
B.Plan (4 years), or B.Arch followed by an M.Plan - the postgraduate route is how many architects enter planning.
State Town & Country Planning department, a development authority, a municipal corporation, a Smart Cities or AMRUT programme unit, or a planning and infrastructure consultancy.

entrance_exams.note: JEE Main Paper 2B is the main national route and it requires only Mathematics in class 12, which is a materially different door from the B.Arch one.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent planning and development consultancy - master plan work, environmental and transport studies, and development applications for private clients. Realistic after eight to ten years and it depends on knowing how a specific authority works.

ai_exposure.reason: Moderately exposed on the analysis and protected on the decision. GIS Planning Analyst and Transport Planner work with spatial models and projections that are increasingly automated, and drafting a standard land-use report is generatable. What does not automate is Development Control Officer: refusing a builder's application under a statutory master plan, and defending that refusal, is authority exercised by a named person who can be sued and pressured.

nuances.statement: Mathematics ONLY, and this is the point of the record. JEE Main Paper 2B requires Maths in class 12 and does NOT require Physics or Chemistry, so a commerce student with Maths can enter the built environment through planning when B.Arch and B.Tech are closed to them. That door is barely known and it is why this profession was added.

Null, and it is the clearest contrast with Architect in this sector. The Architects Act 1972 protects the TITLE 'architect' and the Council of Architecture maintains a register; NOTHING equivalent exists for planners. The Institute of Town Planners India is a voluntary professional body, not a statutory regulator, which is why this record is Tier B and Architect is Tier A.

Kept separate from Architect rather than folded in as job roles, on the merge test in DECISIONS.md 8.95. The object of concern differs - a building against a settlement - and so does the skill set: zoning law, transport modelling, demographic projection and statutory development control have no counterpart in structural design. The entry gates differ too, which is decisive: PCM and a protected title for one, Mathematics alone and no register for the other.

professions.one_liner: Keeps aircraft apart and moving, from a tower or a radar room.

deviating_roles.why: Flight information is an advisory desk - it answers and briefs. Radar control is continuous live separation of aircraft, which is where the concentration load sits.

path_to_entry.requirement: Physics and Maths at class 12
B.Sc with Physics and Maths, or B.E./B.Tech
AAI Junior Executive (Air Traffic Control) computer-based test, followed by a voice test and a psychoactive substance test
Class 1 medical fitness
Ab-initio training at an AAI Civil Aviation Training College, then on-the-job ratings for each control position

public_routes: AAI Junior Executive (Air Traffic Control) recruitment examination
entrance_exams.note: One employer for practical purposes. Air traffic services in India are provided by the Airports Authority of India, so the AAI recruitment examination is the route.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

ai_exposure.reason: Automation assists heavily - conflict alerting, data-link, arrival sequencing - and none of it removes the controller, because the accountability for separation is personal and the job is live judgment under time pressure with no undo. What automation has changed is the volume one controller can handle, not whether one is present.

nuances.statement: Placed in Engineering & Making beside Commercial Pilot and Aircraft Maintenance Engineer, which is the precedent for licensed technical operation of aviation systems. The tension worth knowing: Merchant Navy Deck Officer, who does the equivalent job on a ship, sits in Sector 16 while Marine Engineer sits here. That inconsistency predates this record and is carried on Sector 2's sector_admin_review rather than resolved by moving a built record.

legal_accountability is true with no licensing_body named. A controller's instructions are mandatory in controlled airspace and responsibility for separation is personal and individually attributable after an incident - the same statutory-office pattern as Civil Services Officer and Police Officer, where accountability rests on the office rather than on a council's licence. Whether DGCA additionally issues an air traffic controller licence under the Aircraft Rules is a Tier A question carried on this record's admin_review.

early_earnings is anchored on a document, not an aggregator: AAI Advertisement 02/2025/CHQ gives the approximate CTC for Junior Executive as Rs. 13 lakhs per annum on the E-1 scale of Rs.40000 - 3% - 140000. mid_career is NOT in that document and is judgment. Source: data/verified_facts.json#aai-atc-junior-executive-pay.

admin_review.reason: Two open items. (1) Does DGCA issue an air traffic controller LICENCE under the Aircraft Rules? If it does, this record is Tier A with a named licensing_body, not Tier B. (2) No sourced mid-career figure exists - AAI's advertisement gives entry CTC only, and the E-1 scale's progression to E-2 and above is not quantified in it. The mid_career band is built outward from the sourced entry figure and the published 3% increment, and should be replaced with a fetched figure.

professions.one_liner: Drives the trains, controls their movement and keeps the section safe.

deviating_roles.why: Station and section control is coordination by voice and record under pressure - authorising movements, sequencing trains, handling failures. Driving is a solitary, physical, intensely procedural job in a cab.
Signalling and rolling-stock examination are diagnostic trades - circuits, interlocks and mechanical fault-finding rather than train handling.

path_to_entry.requirement: Class 10 pass
ITI in a relevant trade, or a three-year diploma in mechanical, electrical or electronics engineering, for the Assistant Loco Pilot route. Station Master is recruited at graduate level
RRB Assistant Loco Pilot computer-based tests, followed by a computer-based aptitude test
Railway medical standard A-1, which is the strictest vision standard the Railways apply
Zonal training school, then footplate experience before independent charge of a locomotive

entrance_exams.note: Indian Railways recruits through the Railway Recruitment Boards and almost nowhere else. CEN 01/2026 alone advertised 11,127 Assistant Loco Pilot posts.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

ai_exposure.reason: Driving is physical, procedural and safety-critical, and Indian Railways runs a vast legacy network where automatic train protection is being fitted rather than assumed. Signalling and control absorb more automation than the cab does. The binding constraint is not technology but accountability: a signal passed at danger is attributed to a person.

nuances.statement: Engineering & Making, on the Commercial Pilot precedent - licensed, technical operation of a machine on which other people's lives depend. It is NOT Sector 5 beside Commercial Vehicle Driver: a loco pilot works inside a signalling and control system rather than driving on open road, which is why the section controller and the signal operator belong on the same record and no equivalent exists for road transport.

legal_accountability is true with no licensing_body. Railway operating staff hold competency certificates issued by the Railways themselves and are personally answerable under the Railways Act for signal and safety violations - accountability by office and employer certification rather than by an external council's licence.

The sourced figure is BASIC PAY ONLY: Rs. 19,900 per month at Pay Level-2, from Railway Board CEN 01/2026. Gross pay is materially higher because Dearness Allowance, HRA and the Running Allowance specific to loco staff are added on top, and the Running Allowance can be a large share of a loco pilot's packet. The bands here are built outward from the sourced basic and are judgment. Source: data/verified_facts.json#rrb-alp-cen-01-2026.

One notification, CEN 01/2026, advertised 11,127 Assistant Loco Pilot posts. Indian Railways is among the largest employers in the country and recruits in tens of thousands across categories, which is why india_demand is high and pathway is india - this is domestic public employment, not a transferable international qualification.

admin_review.reason: No sourced figure for GROSS pay or for mid-career earnings. Basic pay at entry is documented (Rs. 19,900, Level-2) but the Running Allowance - which materially changes what a loco pilot actually earns - is not, and neither is the pay level after promotion from Assistant Loco Pilot to Loco Pilot to Mail/Express. Fetch the Railway Board's running allowance rules and the Level-4/Level-6 matrix before treating these bands as reliable.

professions.one_liner: Navigates and commands a cargo ship - the deck side of the merchant marine.

deviating_roles.why: Shore roles - port operations, surveying, ship chartering and management - are where deck officers go after they stop sailing. They pay less than sea time and are the reason the certificate matters beyond the ship.
Eighteen months at sea as a trainee, away from home, on a working ship. It is the hardest filter in this profession and it cannot begin without a shipping company sponsoring the berth.

path_to_entry.requirement: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics with 60 percent aggregate and 50 percent in English. Medical standard is absolute: 6/6 vision without aids and no colour blindness.
IMU CET or a DG Shipping approved institute's admission, plus a company sponsorship test.

Either a one-year Diploma in Nautical Science or a three-year B.Sc Nautical Science, at a DG Shipping approved institute. Both lead to the same certificate and both cost like a degree - the DNS is a one-year course priced in lakhs.
18 months of Structured Shipboard Training as a Deck Cadet. THIS REQUIRES A COMPANY SPONSORSHIP and is the real bottleneck.

Four months post-sea shore training, the STCW courses, and the Second Mates examination conducted by the Directorate General of Shipping. Passing awards the Second Mates (FG) Certificate of Competency.

public_routes: DG Shipping approved pre-sea training admissions
entrance_exams.note: The examination is not the constraint. COMPANY SPONSORSHIP for the 18 months of shipboard training is, and a student can complete the diploma and still be unable to proceed.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

ai_exposure.reason: Very low exposure. Ships are increasingly automated and crewed by fewer people, but a certificated officer must be aboard and personally answerable for the safe navigation of the vessel under international convention. Autonomous shipping is real and slow, and the regulatory requirement for a licensed human on watch is what this profession rests on. Marine Surveyor Trainee and Port Operations Officer carry more exposure through documentation and inspection tooling.

nuances.statement: Tier A. The Second Mates (Foreign Going) Certificate of Competency is issued by the Directorate General of Shipping after its own examination, and serving as a deck officer without one is unlawful. This is the same statutory structure as the MEO certificates recorded for Marine Engineer in Sector 2.

The binding constraint is not academic. Eighteen months of shipboard training requires a shipping company to sponsor a cadet berth, and the number of berths is far smaller than the number of people completing pre-sea courses. Students routinely pay for a diploma and then cannot proceed. Any institute that does not guarantee sponsorship in writing should be treated with suspicion.

The cost of entry is the part students underestimate. A DG Shipping approved pre-sea course is priced in lakhs whether it is the one-year diploma or the three-year degree, it is paid up front, and it does not guarantee the cadet berth that the certificate depends on. Money spent before sponsorship is money at risk.

PCM is required and so is a MEDICAL standard that no other profession in this dataset imposes: uncorrected 6/6 vision and no colour blindness. That excludes a large number of academically eligible students, and it should be checked before any money is spent.

Set level with Marine Engineer in Sector 2 rather than above it. Deck and engine officers hold parallel Certificates of Competency on the same ship under the same international convention, and a gap between them was not defensible. The highest earnings in this sector by a wide margin, and they are earned at sea in tax-advantaged foreign-going service, away from home for months. Shore roles after sailing pay substantially less, which is the trade every officer eventually makes.

Built in Sector 16 and moved here on review. The substitution test decided it: remove travel and hospitality and a deck officer's work - navigation, watchkeeping, cargo, safety - survives completely unchanged, because a cargo ship carries no passengers to host. The setting was doing the work of a sector. It also ends a split that should never have existed: MARINE ENGINEER was already here, and the deck officer holds the parallel Certificate of Competency on the same ship. Two halves of one crew were in two different sectors.

admin_review.reason: The highest figure and the widest spread anywhere in Sectors 8 to 18 - 13 to 32 lakh - and entirely unsourced. Built in Sector 8 and moved here on review. The substitution test decides it: strip the styling and the object still has to be manufacturable, safe, durable and to cost - the engineering constraint is what survives, and it is what the job is actually bounded by. Its industrial tags were already CGSC, FFSC and ASDC: capital goods, furniture and automotive. nuances.statement: The master's is not an advantage here, it is the floor, and this matters because BSc Forensic Science is marketed heavily to Indian students. Several ask for a SUBJECT-SPECIFIC bachelor's underneath it, in chemistry, zoology, botany, biotechnology or physics, with forensic science taken at master's level. A student who takes BSc Forensic Science expecting it to be the qualification has bought the wrong degree.

There is no statutory licensing body and none is named, but FSL recruitment rules act as a hard credential gate in practice: the master's requirement is set in the appointment rules themselves, not by a professional council. The absence of a licence is not an open market here.

Null because NEET has no upper age limit and no cap on attempts. A commerce graduate is not permanently blocked — they can add PCB through NIOS and sit NEET at any age. It is a long cost, roughly 8 years, not a closed door.

A private or deemed seat runs 15-25 lakh a year, 85 lakh to 1.3 crore for the course. Which one a student pays is decided entirely by their NEET rank, not by anything they can plan for.

Null, and it is a serious gap. Attendants handle medication reminders, mobility, catheters and vulnerable adults with no statutory qualification, no register and no background verification requirement. The Nursing councils regulate nurses; nothing regulates this.

Built in Sector 18 and moved here on independent review. The substitution test decided it: swap the home for a hospital ward and the work - bathing, feeding, positioning, mobility, post-operative and palliative support - survives unchanged, so the SETTING is the tag and the object of concern is a dependent person's body. It also belongs beside Nurse and Emergency Medical Technician psychometrically rather than beside Beautician and Tattoo Artist. DECISIONS.md 2.06 had assigned this base layer to Sector 4 all along.

admin_review.reason: No sourced wage figure for Indian home care attendants, agency or private, and the AGENCY MARGIN - the gap between what a family pays and what the attendant receives - is reportedly large and is the single most decision-relevant number for anyone entering this work. Separately, GENERAL DUTY ASSISTANT - the hospital ward counterpart, and the other half of the base layer DECISIONS.md 2.06 assigns to this sector - still has no record anywhere and should be added beside this one.

economics.distribution is 'power_law', which is a statement that the range and the midpoint should not be read as a typical income. Outcomes are extremely dispersed and survivorship bias is severe in every available source. Most new businesses do not reach a stable income at all. The compensation filter does not fire on a power_law record, because deleting a profession on the strength of a number the record itself calls meaningless would be worse than showing it. This record was the FIRST to raise the problem, in Sector 5, and it took five more sectors independently asking for the same exception before the schema was changed.

admin_review.reason: The economics are unlike anything else in the dataset: outcomes are extremely dispersed, survivorship bias is severe in every available source, and a range is close to meaningless. Decide whether to show numbers at all for this record, or present it with the range suppressed and the risk stated instead. Also decide whether it should surface for school-age users at all, or only for college and working-age ones.

professions.one_liner: Drives goods and people for a living under a commercial licence - trucks, buses, ambulances.

deviating_roles.why: These are the salaried, rostered forms of the job - a state transport corporation post is permanent government employment with a pay scale and a pension, and school transport carries a duty of care toward children. Both are the opposite of piece-rate driving.

Carrying fuel, chemicals or explosives requires a hazardous goods endorsement, specific training and route restrictions. It is the best-paid driving work and the consequence of a mistake is not a delayed delivery.

Owning the vehicle changes the job into a business - EMI, fuel, maintenance, load finding and idle days. Instruction is teaching rather than driving. Both are the routes off a wage and both need capital or a licence endorsement.

path_to_entry.requirement: None. Most states require class 8 pass for a transport licence; a few require class 10.

Logistics company, a state transport corporation, a bus operator, a school, a hospital, or a fleet. Corporation posts are filled by state recruitment.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

ai_exposure.reason: Very low exposure today and the largest long-horizon question of any base-layer profession in this dataset. Driving is physical control of a vehicle in unstructured traffic and nothing in the generative-AI wave touches it. AUTONOMOUS DRIVING IS THE REAL QUESTION and it is deliberately not scored as exposure here: Indian road conditions, mixed traffic and liability law make it far more distant than in the countries where the technology is being developed, and there is no sourced Indian timeline. A student entering this trade at 20 should know the question exists without being told a date nobody can source.

nuances.statement: APP-BASED RIDE-HAILING AND FOOD DELIVERY ARE DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from this record, and the exclusion is the most important thing on it. Those are platform gig work: no employer, no ladder, no notice period, earnings claims that are routinely inflated in recruitment marketing, and a vehicle EMI that sits with the driver rather than the platform. This record covers LICENSED COMMERCIAL DRIVING - a transport endorsement, an employer, and in the case of a state transport corporation a permanent post with a pension. They are not the same occupation and presenting them as one is how the whole trade comes to look like gig work.

The employed figure is a driver's wage. Two things sit outside it and both matter more: a state transport corporation post is permanent government employment on a pay scale, and long-haul and hazardous goods driving pays materially above the base-layer trades because India has a documented shortage of licensed heavy vehicle drivers. Neither is sourced here.

High and structurally so - road freight moves the overwhelming majority of Indian goods and the shortage of licensed heavy vehicle drivers is well documented in the logistics industry. This is demand for a licensed skill, not for gig labour.

admin_review.reason: Three gaps. No sourced wage figure for Indian commercial drivers at any level. No figure for what an owner-driver actually clears after EMI, fuel, maintenance and idle days - which is the named route up and the one most likely to be oversold to someone. And a presentation decision this record cannot make: it should be DESCRIBED but arguably never SUGGESTED to a school student, which is the third record to need that distinction after Waste Management & Sanitation Worker and Religious & Ritual Professional.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership is excluded — that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

demand_signal.note: A very small profession in absolute numbers — India has only a few thousand qualified actuaries — but demand comfortably exceeds the qualified supply because the examinations are a severe filter.

self_employment.route: Independent actuarial consulting after qualification, typically to smaller insurers and pension schemes.

ai_exposure.reason: Heavily quantitative but built on foundational mathematics rather than retrievable knowledge, and the output is a professional judgment an insurer relies on. Model automation assists it rather than replacing it.

nuances.statement: Seven years is the realistic figure and it may be optimistic. The professional examinations have low pass rates and are taken alongside full-time work, so many candidates take a decade and a substantial number never complete them. Anyone considering this should treat the exam sequence, not the entrance test, as the real gate.

The Actuaries Act 2006 does not merely regulate the title — its DEFINITION of an actuary includes being a fellow member of the Institute of Actuaries of India. You cannot be an actuary in Indian law without IAI fellowship, which makes this one of the hardest statutory gates in the taxonomy.

professions.one_liner: Studies how money, work and policy move through a whole economy.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream; mathematics is a strong advantage and required by some programmes
BA or B.Sc Economics
MA or M.Sc Economics is the real entry qualification; DSE, ISI, JNU and IGIDR are the recognised routes
RBI and government, banks and rating agencies, think tanks, international organisations

entrance_exams.note: The Indian Economic Service is a separate UPSC examination and is the government career route.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership is excluded — that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent research and policy consulting to think tanks, industry bodies and international agencies.

ai_exposure.reason: Data work and literature summarising are exposed. Framing an economic question and defending a policy judgment in public are not — the clarity and foundational-knowledge shares carry it.

nuances.statement: Routed here from Sector 3 Science & Research. Economics is empirical, but its object of concern is money and value, and it has its own professional sector. Research method alone does not decide the sector when a sector exists for the subject itself.

Corrected from restart_undergrad. An MA or M.Sc Economics does not require a bachelor's in economics — engineering, mathematics, statistics and commerce graduates enter routinely, and several of the strongest Indian programmes prefer a mathematical background over an economics one. The subject gate is mathematics ability, not a prior economics degree.

professions.one_liner: Argues and advises on what the law allows, requires and forbids.

deviating_roles.why: Litigation is performance under pressure — arguing on your feet before a judge who interrupts. Corporate and in-house work in the same profession is drafting and reviewing documents, largely alone and largely silent.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
Five-year integrated LLB after class 12, OR a three-year LLB after any bachelor's degree
Enrol as an advocate with a State Bar Council under the Advocates Act 1961
Pass the All India Bar Examination for the Certificate of Practice
Chambers, law firms, in-house legal teams, or independent practice

entrance_exams.note: CLAT admits to the national law universities. AIBE is not an admission test — it comes after the degree and after Bar Council enrolment.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years post-enrolment, EMPLOYED only. The early band is unusually wide because litigation juniors earn very little for the first years while corporate firm entrants start high.

demand_signal.note: India has an enormous case backlog and a growing corporate compliance load. Demand is high but extremely stratified between tier-1 corporate firms and district courts.

self_employment.route: Independent practice is the traditional shape of the profession — chambers first, then your own. Needs enrolment and a Certificate of Practice rather than capital.

ai_exposure.reason: Research, drafting and document review are exposed and already changing. Advocacy carries personal professional liability and a court will not hear software, which is what protects it.

nuances.statement: Law is one of the most reachable mid-career switches in the taxonomy. The three-year LLB accepts a graduate of ANY discipline, and there is no age limit on Bar Council enrolment or on AIBE attempts. A commerce or engineering graduate at thirty can still become a lawyer.

The widest early-earnings spread in the dataset, and it is structural rather than noisy. A litigation junior in a district court may earn almost nothing for two to three years while a tier-1 corporate firm entrant starts near the top of the band. Which one a student lands in is decided largely by which law school they attended.

professions.one_liner: Makes sure a company follows the law it is required to follow.

path_to_entry.requirement: ANY stream; minimum age 17 for CSEET
CSEET, the ICSI entrance test; graduates with 50 percent may skip it and enter Executive directly
Executive Programme
Professional Programme plus practical training — three to five years in total
Listed companies, which are legally required to appoint one, plus firms in practice

entrance_exams.note: ICSI runs the whole route. Executive and Professional examinations are held twice a year, in June and December.

professions.licensing_body: Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership is excluded — that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

demand_signal.note: Demand is set by statute: every listed company and every company above a paid-up capital threshold must appoint a whole-time Company Secretary. That makes the floor legal rather than economic, but it also caps the size of the profession.

self_employment.route: Practice as a Company Secretary in whole-time practice, doing secretarial audit and compliance for several companies.

ai_exposure.reason: Filings, registers and compliance checklists are highly structured and exposed. A Company Secretary is a Key Managerial Personnel who signs and is personally liable, and liability does not automate.

nuances.statement: NOT a secretary in the clerical sense, not a founder's-office generalist, and not a ministry Secretary — the shared word is a historical accident. Under the Companies Act 2013 a Company Secretary is a Key Managerial Personnel ranked alongside the CEO and CFO, mandatory for listed companies and personally liable for the company's regulatory filings.

Sits in Law, Governance & Public Service rather than Finance. Apply the sector test: delete company law and the role disappears entirely. Its object of concern is whether the organisation obeys the law, which is governance, not money. It is a separate profession from Corporate Lawyer — different statutory qualification, different daily work.

professions.one_liner: Runs the machinery of government — a district, a department, a policy.

deviating_roles.why: Diplomacy is language, negotiation and living abroad for a career. District administration in the same service is field work — floods, elections, law and order, on the ground.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream — the examination has no subject requirement
A bachelor's degree in ANY discipline
UPSC Civil Services Examination: Prelims, Mains and Interview
LBSNAA or the relevant service academy
Allocated to a service and a cadre

entrance_exams.note: Minimum age 21. General: 32 years and 6 attempts. OBC: 35 and 9. SC/ST: 37 with unlimited attempts.

entry_window.constrained_route: UPSC CSE — age 32 and 6 attempts for General, 35 and 9 for OBC, 37 and unlimited for SC/ST. State PSC examinations have their own, often later, limits.
entry_window.bypass: State Public Service Commission examinations, which usually allow older candidates than UPSC - several states run to 38 or 40 - and the Indian Economic Service and other specialist UPSC examinations with their own limits.

economics.basis: Pay follows central government pay matrices. CTC comparison understates the package — housing, medical, pension and allowances are not in the figure.

demand_signal.note: A few hundred posts a year against roughly a million applicants. Demand for the ROLE is permanent and the state will always need administrators; the constraint is the examination, not the need.

ai_exposure.reason: Discretionary authority exercised under law, with personal accountability for the decision. File processing and drafting are exposed; deciding, and answering for it, is not.

nuances.statement: The hardest genuine entry window in the taxonomy, and unlike JEE there is no lateral route around it. It is not a hard block because 32 is late enough that a graduate of any age under it can still start, and state service commissions often allow older candidates.

The most under-measured compensation in the dataset. Government housing, medical cover, pension terms and the authority attached to the post are a large part of why people pursue this, and none of it appears in a salary figure.

legal_accountability is true with no licensing_body, and that is correct rather than an omission. A District Magistrate is personally answerable by virtue of STATUTORY OFFICE under the CrPC, the revenue codes and service conduct rules - not through a professional council. No body licenses civil servants; the state appoints them and the law holds them liable.

admin_review.reason: SUCCESS RATE. Roughly a million candidates compete for a few hundred posts, and many spend three to six prime years preparing full time, often with no fallback. The record currently presents this like any other examination route. Decide how the opportunity cost of preparation should be shown — it is the single largest unmeasured risk in the taxonomy.

professions.one_liner: Enforces the law, investigates crime and keeps public order.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream; constable recruitment often takes class 12 alone
A bachelor's for Sub-Inspector and IPS; not required for constable
State police recruitment boards, SSC CPO, or UPSC CSE for the IPS
Physical standards and endurance tests are a genuine second gate
State police academy or SVPNPA for the IPS

entrance_exams.note: Written examination plus physical efficiency tests. Age limits vary by state and by rank.

economics.basis: Government pay matrices, EMPLOYED only. Housing, medical and pension are excluded from the figure and are a material part of the package.

demand_signal.note: India is police-deficient against its own sanctioned strength, and state recruitment drives run in large cycles. One of the largest formal employers of non-graduates and general graduates in the country.

ai_exposure.reason: Physical presence, statutory authority and personal accountability. Record-keeping and some analysis are exposed; arresting someone, and answering for it in court, is not.

nuances.statement: Police sits here under the cross-cutting rule: a uniformed identity whose work exists because the state exists belongs to Sector 7. A forensic scientist employed by the same police department does NOT — they keep their home sector with a government tag.

legal_accountability is true with no licensing_body. Powers of arrest, search and seizure, and personal liability for their misuse, come from the Police Acts and the CrPC rather than from any licensing council.

Entry is controlled by examination — UPSC Civil Services for the IPS, SSC CPO and state police recruitment boards for Sub-Inspector and Constable. Tier B rather than C: an authority decides who enters, even though no council licenses the profession afterwards. State recruitment rules vary and were not individually verified.

professions.one_liner: Commands soldiers, sailors or aircrew in the Indian Armed Forces.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream for NDA Army; Physics and Maths required for NDA Air Force and Navy
NDA after class 12, or CDS and AFCAT after a degree, or technical and short-service entries
Services Selection Board — five days of psychological and group testing, the real filter
IMA, INA, AFA or OTA
Permanent or Short Service Commission

entrance_exams.note: The SSB interview, not the written examination, is where most candidates are filtered out.

entry_window.constrained_route: Age limits are strict and vary by entry: NDA is roughly 16.5 to 19.5, CDS and AFCAT run to about 25, and technical and short-service entries have their own bands.
entry_window.bypass: If the NDA window closes at about 19.5, CDS and AFCAT reopen entry after a degree to about 25, and technical, JAG and short-service entries run later still with their own bands.

economics.basis: Defence pay matrix with Military Service Pay, EMPLOYED only. Housing, medical, canteen, pension and post-retirement benefits are excluded and are a large part of the package.

ai_exposure.reason: Physical, hierarchical and accountable command under conditions no system is trusted to hold. Analysis and logistics are exposed; leading people who may be hurt is not.

nuances.statement: Here rather than in Engineering & Making even for technical entries. The cross-cutting rule turns on IDENTITY: an officer is an officer first and an engineer second. A civilian engineer working for DRDO keeps Sector 2 with a defence tag.

Age limits here are genuinely tight and are the tightest in the taxonomy for the NDA route, which closes at about 19.5. Unlike the civil services there is no later route that reopens at thirty, so a student who wants this has to decide early.

legal_accountability is true with no licensing_body. An officer is subject to the Army, Navy or Air Force Act and is personally answerable under military law - a stricter accountability than most licences impose, and one no council administers.

Entry is controlled by examination — NDA and CDS are conducted by UPSC, AFCAT by the Air Force. Tier B rather than C. The SSB interview, not the written paper, is where most candidates are filtered out, and that stage is not an examination in the ordinary sense.

professions.one_liner: Sits as a judge in the district courts and decides cases.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
LLB — five-year integrated after class 12, or three-year after any degree
Bar Council enrolment; some states require years of practice for the higher entry
State Judicial Services Examination, conducted by the High Court or State PSC
Appointment as a Civil Judge, then progression through the district judiciary

entrance_exams.note: Conducted state by state. The junior entry usually allows fresh law graduates; the higher entry requires about seven years of practice.

economics.basis: Judicial pay follows its own commission-set scales, EMPLOYED only. Housing, staff and pension are excluded from the figure.

demand_signal.note: India's subordinate judiciary runs with a large number of sanctioned posts vacant against an enormous pending caseload, so recruitment is regular and the need is structural.

ai_exposure.reason: The highest combined foundational-knowledge and clarity share in the taxonomy. Judging is applying law to disputed facts and being personally accountable for the outcome — the most structurally protected work in the dataset.

nuances.statement: A separate profession from Lawyer, not a senior version of one. Entry is by a distinct state examination taken after the LLB, and many judicial officers are appointed as fresh law graduates without practising as advocates at all.

Null, and it was WRONG before - this record named the Bar Council of India. A judge does not practise under a BCI licence. An advocate who takes full-time service is moved to the non-practising list and surrenders their enrolment certificate, and the BCI has no power to strike off a judge. BCI enrolment is a PREREQUISITE for eligibility, which is a path_to_entry step, not a licence to practise. Control over the subordinate judiciary vests in the High Court under Article 235 of the Constitution, which is appointment and discipline rather than licensing.

legal_accountability is true with no licensing_body, on the same statutory-office footing as Civil Services Officer, Police Officer and Armed Forces Officer in this sector. A judge is personally answerable for judicial orders by virtue of holding office, and the orders are appealable. There is no unlicensed version of this work to police: you cannot practise as a judge without being appointed one, which is why the licensing frame does not apply here at all.

'undergrad' understates the qualification slightly and is the accurate value for how this profession is ENTERED. An LLB is a professional degree, but this record is not a licensed practice - it is an office reached by appointment after a state examination, exactly like the three other uniformed and administrative services in this sector, all of which are 'undergrad'. The LLB requirement is carried in path_to_entry where it belongs.

professions.one_liner: Researches and designs the rules and programmes governments run on.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
Any bachelor's; economics, law, political science and engineering all feed in
MPP or MA in public policy is the usual entry qualification
Think tanks, LAMP fellowships, government advisory units, foundations, corporate government-affairs teams

public_routes: Institute entrances (NLS, TISS, Ashoka, IIM public policy)
entrance_exams.note: No single national gate; admission is programme by programme.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership is excluded — that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

demand_signal.note: A young and growing field in India — think tanks, philanthropic funders and corporate government-affairs teams have expanded it well beyond the civil service.

self_employment.route: Independent policy consulting to foundations, industry bodies and international organisations.

ai_exposure.reason: Literature review and drafting are exposed. Deciding which problem a policy should solve, and for whom, is the clarity that carries this profession.

nuances.statement: Distinct from Research Psychologist and other Sector 3 researchers, which study the world to know it. Policy work exists to CHANGE what the state does — without a state there is no policy profession, which is the Sector 7 test.

professions.one_liner: Does the research, drafting and paperwork a legal team runs on.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream
Paralegal or legal-support diploma; a BA LLB is not required
Any bachelor's helps; law graduates awaiting enrolment often start here
Law firms, in-house legal teams, legal process outsourcing firms, courts

entrance_exams.note: No entrance exam. Hired on drafting ability and attention to detail.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership is excluded — that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

demand_signal.note: India's legal process outsourcing industry serves United States and United Kingdom firms at scale, which is where much of this employment actually sits.

self_employment.route: Freelance contract drafting and documentation support for small firms and startups.

ai_exposure.reason: THE MOST EXPOSED PROFESSION IN THIS SECTOR by a wide margin. Document review, contract abstraction and legal research are exactly what language models do well, and legal process outsourcing is built on that work. There is no licence and no personal liability to protect it.

nuances.statement: The base layer of the legal pyramid, listed beside Lawyer at its apex. It is also the only unlicensed profession in this sector, which is exactly why it is the most AI-exposed one — the licence and the liability are what protect the others.

admin_review.reason: Highest AI exposure in Sector 7 and no licence to protect it, in a profession whose Indian employment sits largely in legal process outsourcing for foreign firms — the segment most directly substitutable. It is also a genuine entry route for law graduates awaiting enrolment. Decide how strongly to frame the exposure.

professions.one_liner: Runs towards fires, collapses and accidents to get people out.

path_to_entry.requirement: Class 12 in any stream; some state cadres take class 10
Height, chest, endurance and running standards - a genuine and strict gate
State fire service or municipal corporation recruitment; some states recruit through the police board
State fire service training academy
State fire services, municipal corporations, airports, refineries, large industrial plants

entrance_exams.note: Written test plus physical efficiency. Age and physical standards vary by state.

economics.basis: State pay matrices, EMPLOYED only. Housing, medical and pension sit outside the figure and are a material part of the package.

demand_signal.note: Indian fire services run understaffed against their own sanctioned strength, and industrial and airport fire safety adds private demand on top of municipal.

ai_exposure.reason: Among the least exposed work in the entire taxonomy. Entering a burning building and cutting someone out of a car is physical, unstructured and irreducibly human.

nuances.statement: Routed here from Sector 2, where Fire & Safety Engineer sits. The split is that the engineer DESIGNS systems so a fire never starts, which is engineering; the firefighter is a uniformed public servant who responds when it does, which is the Sector 7 cross-cutting rule.

professions.one_liner: Writes and files patents, and argues for them at the patent office.

path_to_entry.requirement: Science stream in practice, because the degree below requires it

A degree in science, pharmacy, engineering or technology from a university established under Indian law — a hard requirement under Section 126 of the Patents Act 1970. A law degree alone does NOT qualify you.
The Patent Agent Examination conducted by the Indian Patent Office
Registration on the Register of Patent Agents
IP law firms, corporate IP teams, research organisations, IP analytics firms

entrance_exams.note: The examination requires a science or technology degree. There is no alternative qualification.

professions.licensing_body: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (Register of Patent Agents)

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership is excluded — that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

demand_signal.note: India files a growing number of patents and does large volumes of IP support work for foreign firms, but the registered patent agent population is small.

self_employment.route: Independent patent practice once registered - drafting and prosecution for startups and research institutions.

ai_exposure.reason: Prior-art searching and first-draft claim writing are directly exposed. A registered agent signs filings and answers for them, and the claim-drafting judgment that decides how broad a patent is remains the craft.

nuances.statement: Routed here from Sector 3. The subject matter is science but the work is law - delete the Patents Act and the profession disappears, which is the Sector 7 test. Sector 3 keeps the research the patent describes.

The requirement runs opposite to most legal careers: a SCIENCE OR ENGINEERING degree is mandatory and a law degree alone does not qualify you to sit the examination. One of the few routes where a B.Tech or B.Sc graduate has an advantage over an LLB holder.

Section 126 of the Patents Act 1970 sets four conditions: Indian citizenship, age at least 21, a science, pharmacy, engineering or technology degree from an Indian university, and passing the qualifying examination — or ten years of service as a patent examiner. Section 125 requires the Controller General to maintain the Register of Patent Agents, and until your name is on it you cannot lawfully practise. That makes this Tier A in the strict sense: practising unregistered is unlawful, not merely unrecognised.

professions.one_liner: Runs the campaigns, research and ground operations that politics is fought with.

deviating_roles.why: Constituency modelling, survey analysis and booth-level targeting are quantitative desk work. The rest of this profession is persuasion and organisation carried out in person.
Field organisation is months of travel, long days and constant contact with people who owe you nothing.

path_to_entry.requirement: No qualification gates this work. Entry is by working on a campaign, usually as a volunteer or field associate first
A degree in politics, economics, statistics, law or communication helps and is not required. Data roles in practice expect statistics
A cycle with a political consulting firm, a party research cell, or a legislator's office
Campaign-to-campaign progression. The work is cyclical and follows the election calendar

entrance_exams.note: There is no entrance examination and no licence. Political consulting firms, party research cells and legislative offices hire directly, and a campaign cycle is the credential.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent political consultants and small campaign shops are common, and a consultant who has delivered a state campaign can bill directly. The work is cyclical, so income arrives in bursts around elections rather than monthly.

ai_exposure.reason: Polling analysis, message testing and voter targeting absorb automation quickly, and generative tools already draft political content at scale. What does not automate is the part that decides elections: knowing a constituency, holding a coalition of local workers together, and being trusted by people who will do unglamorous work for you.

nuances.statement: No degree grants this work and none is required to do it. Entry is through campaign work itself. This is a real 'none' and not a placeholder: political consulting firms recruit graduates from every discipline, and the qualification that counts is having run something.

Law, Governance & Public Service, whose object of concern is the state and public power. It sits beside Public Policy Professional deliberately: policy work designs what a government does, this profession contests who gets to. The skill sets are different enough - field organisation, persuasion and voter data against research and drafting - that the merge test in DECISIONS.md 8.95 keeps them apart.

ELECTED OFFICE IS NOT WHAT THIS RECORD DESCRIBES. Becoming an MLA, MP or Sarpanch is the outcome many people in this work aim at, and no route in this record or anywhere else guarantees it - there is no course, no entrance examination and no qualification for being elected. What this profession describes is the paid, learnable work that surrounds politics and exists whether or not any individual ever stands for office. A student who wants to be a politician should be told both halves of that.

Anchored on reported pay at India's largest political consulting firm - Analyst around 6.7 lakh, Campaign Manager around 11.1 lakh, Lead Analyst around 15.6 lakh, from Indeed's employer page. It is a salary aggregator, which CLAUDE.md says never to trust alone, and there is no statutory pay for this work to anchor on instead. Party and legislative-office roles pay materially less than consulting firms and are not represented in that figure.

admin_review.reason: The pay figures come from a single commercial aggregator covering ONE employer, and this profession has no statutory pay anywhere to anchor against. Party research cells, legislative offices and small state-level consultancies almost certainly pay far less than the national firms these numbers describe, and none of that is sourced. Also unresolved: the record deliberately excludes elected office, and the application must decide how to present a profession whose most visible outcome is one the data explicitly refuses to promise.

professions.one_liner: Makes information look right and read clearly - logos, packaging, posters, brand systems.

deviating_roles.why: Motion work is timing, sequencing and software pipelines - nearer to animation than to the typography and copy-driven judgment the rest of the profession runs on.
Identity work is argued for in a boardroom before it is drawn. The job is persuading people what a company should look like, not executing a brief someone else settled.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream. No subject is required.
A 1-2 year diploma in graphic or communication design, or a B.Des. Neither is legally required.
Build a portfolio of 10-15 real pieces. This, not the certificate, is what gets read at hiring.
Junior designer at a studio, agency or in-house brand team; or freelance from the portfolio directly.

entrance_exams.note: Neither exam is required. They are the route into a B.Des at a public design institute, and most working graphic designers in India sat neither.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and studio ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Freelance and small-studio work built off the same portfolio used to get hired; a one-person studio serving local businesses is the commonest form.

ai_exposure.reason: The most exposed profession in this sector. Generative image tools now produce competent layouts, social creatives and packaging mockups from a prompt, and that is exactly the entry-level work a junior is hired to do. Social Media Creative Designer and Layout & Publication Designer face this first. Brand Identity Designer is the protected end - the work there is deciding what a company should look like and defending the call to people who disagree, which is clarity, not output.

nuances.statement: There is no qualification here at all. The portfolio IS the credential, and a self-taught designer with good work competes directly with a B.Des graduate. That cuts both ways: entry is genuinely open, and nothing protects the practitioner from being undercut.

The bottom rung is shrinking, not the profession. Studios still need someone to decide what is right and take responsibility for it - what they need fewer of is people to produce the twentieth variation of a banner.

professions.one_liner: Designs how an app or website works and feels, so people can use it without being taught.

deviating_roles.why: Research is interviewing strangers, watching them struggle and synthesising what they could not articulate. No visual composition is involved at all.
A design system is infrastructure - naming, tokens, consistency and documentation used by other designers. It rewards rigour and punishes invention.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream.
B.Des, or any bachelor's degree followed by a UX course. Psychology, English and engineering graduates all enter this way.
Three or four case studies showing a problem, the research, the decisions and the outcome - not just screens.
Junior UX or UI designer on a product team.

entrance_exams.note: Neither is required and neither is the usual route. This profession absorbs graduates from every discipline, which is why entry_competition is null.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and studio ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Freelance product design for startups, or a small independent studio. Common after 4-6 years, once a case-study portfolio can win work on its own.

ai_exposure.reason: Screens generate easily; understanding does not. UI Designer is the exposed role - tools already produce clean, conventional layouts from a description. UX Researcher and Service Designer are the protected end, for the same reason an IT Business Analyst is: the work is establishing what a room of people who disagree actually need, and a model cannot know whose problem it is.

nuances.statement: Routed here from Sector 1. The tools are digital and the employer is usually a software company, but the object of concern is the person using the product - swap the software out for a hospital form or an ATM and the work survives unchanged.

Null on purpose. This is one of the few well-paid Indian professions with no gate of any kind - no exam, no licence, no required degree subject. A commerce or arts graduate can enter it directly, which is rare in this dataset.

professions.one_liner: Makes drawings and digital models move - for film, series, games and advertising.

deviating_roles.why: Roto and matchmove are high-volume precision tasks done to a deadline against a reference plate. They are the industry's entry rung and the reason India has so many VFX jobs - and they involve no authorship whatsoever.
Storyboarding is narrative work - deciding what the audience sees and when. It is closer to directing than to any other role in the profession.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream.
B.Sc or BA in Animation, B.Des, or any degree plus a 1-2 year animation and VFX diploma.
A 60-90 second showreel in ONE discipline. Studios hire for a seat on a pipeline, not for general ability.
Junior artist at a VFX or animation studio, usually starting on roto, paint or matchmove.

entrance_exams.note: Neither is required. Most entrants come through private animation institutes or a university B.Sc, and are hired on the showreel.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and studio ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Freelance shots and sequences for studios, which is how a large part of the industry already works; established artists take contract work directly from overseas clients.

ai_exposure.reason: Generative video and automated rotoscoping attack this profession from the bottom, which is the worst place to be attacked. Roto & Paint Artist and Matchmove Artist are the exposed roles, and they are precisely the rungs India's outsourced VFX industry hires at volume. Character Rigger, Lighting & Rendering Artist and Storyboard Artist are more protected - rigging is engineering a puppet that must behave under any motion, and storyboarding is narrative judgment.

nuances.statement: Pathway is 'any' because India is a global outsourcing centre for VFX and animation post-production, so a large share of the work is done here for foreign studios. That is also the vulnerability: the same economics that brought the work can move it.

The bottom rung is shrinking, not the career. A rigger or a lighting artist with five years of pipeline experience is not replaceable by a prompt - but the roto seat that used to be how those five years began is.

professions.one_liner: Draws what does not exist yet - characters, worlds, book art, comics and editorial images.

deviating_roles.why: Accuracy to an anatomical, botanical or mechanical fact outranks invention entirely. The client is a textbook or a surgeon, and being interesting is not the brief.
Sequential art is storytelling under a page count. The artist is usually also the author, carrying pacing and dialogue as well as drawing.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream.
Draw for two to three years and build a body of work. A BFA or design diploma helps and is not required.
A public portfolio and a visible style. Commissions come from being findable.
Commissions from publishers, studios and agencies; or a staff concept artist seat at a game or animation studio.

entrance_exams.note: None. Entry is entirely by portfolio.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and studio ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Commissions taken directly from publishers, studios and agencies, plus print and licensing income from your own work. Most illustrators are self-employed from day one.

ai_exposure.reason: The single most exposed profession in this dataset, and it would be dishonest to soften it. Text-to-image models were trained on exactly this output and produce it at near-zero marginal cost. Editorial Illustrator, Matte Painter and general Illustrator commissions are already contracting. What holds: Scientific & Medical Illustrator, where a named human is accountable for the accuracy of a diagram a surgeon will rely on, and Comic & Graphic Novel Artist, where the reader is buying an authored voice across hundreds of pages, not an image.
