Programme induction training, usually run by the implementing agency or the state rural livelihoods mission.
State rural livelihoods mission, an NGO project, a self-help group federation, or a scheme delivery unit.
Cluster or block coordination, or running a village-level enterprise on commission.

entrance_exams.note: Recruitment is local and by the implementing agency, usually with a residence requirement rather than an examination.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: A village-level enterprise on commission - common service centre, banking correspondent, agri-input or insurance agency. This is the realistic route above a programme honorarium, and it is a business rather than a promotion.

ai_exposure.reason: Almost unexposed. The work is walking to households, holding meetings, and being a person the village already knows and trusts. Block Programme Assistant carries the only meaningful exposure, through scheme reporting that has largely moved onto phone applications - which has changed the job rather than removed it.

nuances.statement: The base layer of the development sector, and it fails the compensation filter. Most of these roles are paid a project honorarium or a per-activity incentive rather than a salary, on contracts tied to a scheme's funding period. There is no pay scale and usually no notice period.

Moderate and geographically inverted relative to most of this dataset - these posts exist in rural blocks and small towns and barely exist in metros. For a student outside a city this is often the only formal development-sector entry available locally.

admin_review.reason: No sourced figure for community worker honoraria or for the commission a village level entrepreneur earns, and the second is the entire route out of a 2.7 LPA ceiling. Both vary by state and by scheme, which is exactly why an unsourced national range is close to meaningless here.

professions.one_liner: Makes work, buildings and services usable by disabled people, and supports them into them.

deviating_roles.why: Auditing a building or a website against an accessibility standard is technical compliance work with a written specification. It is closer to inspection than to rehabilitation.

Interpreting is real-time bilingual performance between Indian Sign Language and a spoken language. It is a language profession that happens to sit in disability services, and India has very few qualified interpreters.
CBR work is home visits in villages, teaching families to do therapy themselves because no therapist will ever come. It is the largest and least paid part of this profession.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream.
A bachelor's degree, then an RCI-recognised qualification for the rehabilitation roles, or a specialist course for interpreting and accessibility.
Enrolment on the Central Rehabilitation Register IF the role is one the RCI Act lists - vocational counsellors and multi-purpose rehabilitation workers are listed; accessibility auditors are not.
Disability NGO, a national institute, a state disability commissioner's office, a company's inclusion team, or an accessibility consultancy.

entrance_exams.note: There is no single gate, because the profession spans RCI-registered rehabilitation roles and entirely unregulated technical ones.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent accessibility auditing and inclusion consultancy, which has become a real market since the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016 made compliance a legal obligation for employers and public buildings.

ai_exposure.reason: Low exposure with an unusual twist: the technologies that automate parts of this profession are the same ones that expand what disabled people can do independently. Sign Language Interpreter faces genuine competition from automated interpretation, though Indian Sign Language is poorly resourced and that is some way off. Community Based Rehabilitation Worker and Vocational Rehabilitation Counsellor are protected by home visits and by RCI accountability.

nuances.statement: Null at the profession level, but NOT for every role inside it. The RCI Act lists vocational counsellors and employment officers dealing with the handicapped, and multi-purpose rehabilitation workers, among rehabilitation professionals - those require Central Rehabilitation Register enrolment. Accessibility Auditor and Sign Language Interpreter do not. A student must check which role they are entering.

Moderate and rising for a specific legal reason: the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016 places obligations on employers, public buildings and services, which created a compliance market where there had been only charity.

professions.one_liner: Protects children at risk - abuse, trafficking, child labour, adoption and institutional care.

deviating_roles.why: These roles accompany a child through a criminal process - police, medical examination, court testimony. They are statutory appointments with defined legal duties and they require holding steady in an adversarial setting.
Outreach is street and railway-station work with children who have run away or been trafficked. It is night work in unsafe places and it is the sharpest end of this profession.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream.
MSW, psychology, sociology, child development or law. Statutory posts specify qualifications and experience with children.
District Child Protection Unit, a Child Care Institution, Childline, or a child rights NGO.
Appointment to a statutory role under the Juvenile Justice Act or POCSO framework, which carries defined legal duties.

public_routes: State District Child Protection Unit recruitment
entrance_exams.note: Statutory child protection posts are filled by state recruitment against qualifications set in the Juvenile Justice rules, rather than by a competitive national examination.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

ai_exposure.reason: Very low exposure. The work is interviewing frightened children, judging whether a home is safe, and being personally answerable under the Juvenile Justice Act and POCSO for a decision about a child's life. Case documentation is the only exposed part, and it is documentation that a court will read.

nuances.statement: legal_accountability is true without a licensing body, which is permitted for the same reason it is on a District Magistrate in Sector 7: the accountability rests on STATUTORY OFFICE. Persons appointed under the Juvenile Justice Act and the POCSO framework carry personal legal duties in respect of a named child, enforceable in court.

Rare, and it is one of the few professions in Sectors 8 to 13 where that is true. Child protection authority derives from a statutory post or an accredited institution - there is no independent version of this work, and anyone offering one should be treated with suspicion.

Moderate, and constrained by sanctioned posts rather than by need. District Child Protection Units are mandated nationally and are widely understaffed, which is a funding fact rather than a demand signal.

professions.one_liner: Builds and runs the systems that clean up what industry and cities produce.

deviating_roles.why: Running an effluent or sewage treatment plant is shift work on live process equipment with statutory discharge limits. It is operations rather than design, and it is where most environmental engineering jobs in India actually are.
Compliance work is consents, returns and inspections with the State Pollution Control Board. It is regulatory rather than technical and sits closest to law.

path_to_entry.requirement: Physics and Mathematics. Chemistry is NOT compulsory - JEE Main Paper 1 accepts Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology or a technical vocational subject as the third.
JEE Main, a state engineering entrance, or a private university entrance.
B.Tech in Environmental Engineering, or Civil or Chemical Engineering with an environmental specialisation.
Environmental consultancy, an industrial EHS department, a water or waste utility, or an EPC contractor building treatment plants.

entrance_exams.note: Entry is the ordinary engineering route. GATE matters for M.Tech and for public sector pollution control board posts.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: An independent environmental consultancy doing consents, monitoring and compliance reporting for small industry. A common step after eight to ten years, and it depends on relationships with the State Pollution Control Board.

ai_exposure.reason: Low exposure and protected by physical infrastructure. A treatment plant is pumps, blowers and biology that must be kept alive, and ETP & STP Operations Engineer is nearly untouched. Environmental Compliance Engineer carries the exposure - consent applications, returns and standard reports are documentation work that generates well - but the signature on a statutory return still belongs to a person the board can act against.

nuances.statement: Moderate and regulation-driven rather than market-driven, which makes it unusually predictable. Every industrial unit needs consent to operate and every city needs sewage treated, so demand tracks enforcement capacity rather than the economy. Where enforcement is weak, so is hiring.

Promised here from Sector 2 and it belongs here on the substitution test, narrowly. Remove the environment and a treatment plant engineer is a process engineer - but the object of concern is what happens to the discharge after it leaves the fence, and that is not a manufacturing question.

professions.one_liner: Measures what is happening to air, water, soil and ecosystems, and what a project will do.

deviating_roles.why: Environmental Impact Assessment is a regulatory document prepared for a clearance process, argued at public hearings and defended before an appraisal committee. It is part science and part advocacy, and the accredited coordinator signs it.

Monitoring and laboratory work is standardised sampling and analysis to a method, with chain-of-custody discipline. It is the entry job and it is where the data every other role depends on comes from.
Biodiversity survey is fieldwork - transects, camera traps, species identification - often in difficult terrain and over seasons.

path_to_entry.requirement: Science stream in practice; Biology or Chemistry are the usual routes and neither is formally required for every programme.
BSc in Environmental Science, or any science degree followed by an MSc in Environmental Science.
MSc is effectively the entry qualification for anything beyond laboratory analysis.
For EIA work, NABET/QCI accreditation as a Functional Area Expert or EIA Coordinator - this is what lets you sign a report.
Environmental consultancy, a pollution control board, an industrial EHS team, a research institute or an NGO.

entrance_exams.note: The accreditation, not the degree, is the gate that matters commercially - an EIA report has to be signed by an accredited coordinator.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent consultancy once NABET-accredited, which is the credential that lets you sign reports rather than prepare them for someone else's signature.

ai_exposure.reason: Low exposure, protected by sampling. Somebody has to be at the outfall with a bottle and at the stack with a probe, and Environmental Monitoring Analyst and Biodiversity Assessment Specialist are field jobs. EIA Consultant carries the real exposure: an EIA report is a long document assembled to a template from monitoring data, and much of the drafting is generatable. The accreditation and the public hearing are what a model cannot supply.

nuances.statement: Null, but NOT unconstrained. NABET accreditation under the Quality Council of India determines who may sign an Environmental Impact Assessment report, which is a genuine commercial gate created by the environmental clearance process rather than by a professions statute. It is closer to an auditor's empanelment than to a licence.

Moderate. The volume of work follows the environmental clearance pipeline - infrastructure, mining and industrial projects - so it moves with capital investment cycles rather than with environmental need.

professions.one_liner: Turns satellite imagery and maps into answers about land, water, forests and cities.

deviating_roles.why: The modelling end - machine learning on imagery, change detection, time series. It sits closer to a Data Scientist in Sector 1 than to mapping, and it pays accordingly.
Digitising cadastral records is high-volume government work with legal consequences for land title. It is the largest single employer of GIS people in India and the least glamorous.
Drone survey involves flying and field work as well as processing, and it is regulated - the pilot needs a DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate, which the analyst may not.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream. Mathematics and Geography both help.
Geography, geology, environmental science, civil engineering, computer science or planning - all are normal routes in.
A postgraduate diploma or MSc in GIS and Remote Sensing, or demonstrable skill with QGIS, ArcGIS, Google Earth Engine and Python.
Government mapping and land records programmes, ISRO and state remote sensing centres, urban planning bodies, environmental consultancies, or private geospatial firms.

public_routes: IIRS and state remote sensing centre courses
entrance_exams.note: No profession-specific gate. Entry is on demonstrable tooling skill, which makes this one of the more open technical professions in the dataset.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent geospatial services - drone survey, mapping and land records work for local bodies and developers. Owning a survey drone changes the economics, and the operator needs a DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate.

ai_exposure.reason: The most exposed profession in this sector. Automated feature extraction, change detection and classification from satellite imagery are exactly what computer vision does, and Cartographer and much routine GIS Analyst work is already substantially automated. What survives is at both ends: Drone Survey Analyst because someone must fly and ground-truth, and Geospatial Data Scientist because building the models is the work rather than the casualty. Land Records Digitisation Specialist is protected for an unglamorous reason - the source documents are handwritten, disputed and legally consequential.

nuances.statement: Promised here from Sector 3 rather than kept with the sciences. The method is technical and could sit almost anywhere; the object of concern is land, water and ecosystems, which is this sector. The tagging to IT-ITES and EXT-GOVT is the honest signal that a GIS analyst's employer is very often neither environmental nor scientific.
Moderate, and unusually policy-anchored: the largest single driver in India is government land records digitisation and urban mapping under national programmes, not private-sector demand.

professions.one_liner: Protects forests and wildlife - as a government officer, a researcher, or with communities.

deviating_roles.why: Forest service is law enforcement and administration - a Range Officer holds statutory powers of search, seizure and prosecution under the Forest and Wildlife Acts, manages staff and budgets, and is transferred at the state's discretion.
Research is survey design, data and publication rather than enforcement. It is the route through an MSc in Wildlife Science rather than through a public service examination, and it pays far less.
The base layer, and the most dangerous work in this sector. Patrolling on foot in difficult terrain against armed poachers, usually on contract or daily wage, is what protection actually consists of.
These roles work WITH the people living around a forest rather than policing them, and the skill is negotiation with communities whose livelihood the forest law restricts.

path_to_entry.requirement: Science stream for the IFS route - the degree must include a listed science, or be in agriculture, forestry or engineering.
BSc in a science, forestry, agriculture or engineering. For research, an MSc in Wildlife Science or Ecology.
UPSC Indian Forest Service for the All-India cadre; state forest service and Range Officer examinations for the far larger state cadres.
Indira Gandhi National Forest Academy for IFS officers, or a state forest training institute.
Forest department, a protected area, a research institute, or a conservation NGO.

public_routes: State Forest Range Officer and Forest Guard recruitment
entrance_exams.note: The IFS preliminary examination is the same paper as the Civil Services preliminary, so the two routes share preparation entirely.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

ai_exposure.reason: Among the least exposed professions in the dataset. The work is being physically present in a forest - patrolling, identifying, seizing, negotiating - and a Range Officer's statutory powers require a person to exercise them. Wildlife Biologist carries the only real exposure, through automated species identification from camera trap images, which has changed the method rather than the job.

nuances.statement: One figure across two very different careers, and the record should be read with that in mind. An IFS officer enters on a Group A pay scale with housing and a pension; a Forest Guard is increasingly hired on contract or daily wage and earns a fraction of it, while doing the patrolling that carries the physical risk. The mid_career figure describes the officer end. This is the same bimodal problem as School Teacher in Sector 12 and MBBS cost in Sector 4.

legal_accountability is true with no licensing body, on the statutory-office precedent used for District Magistrate and Police Officer in Sector 7. A Forest Range Officer exercises powers of search, seizure and prosecution under the Indian Forest Act and the Wild Life (Protection) Act, and is personally answerable for their exercise.

Rare, and unusually clearly so. Forest protection authority derives entirely from statutory office - there is no independent version. The conservation NGO and research roles are employed too. Nature Interpretation Guide is the single exception and is a tourism livelihood rather than a conservation career.

Low in the sense that matters: 150 IFS posts a year nationally, and state Range Officer recruitment is intermittent. The Forest Guard cadre is far larger and is increasingly filled on contract and daily wage rather than as permanent posts.

professions.one_liner: Measures and reports what a company does to the environment and society, to a legal standard.

deviating_roles.why: These are technical, on-site roles - walking a plant or a building, metering, and modelling energy use. Energy auditing is also certified by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency, which the reporting roles are not.

Assurance is auditing someone else's sustainability claims to a standard, usually from inside an accountancy firm. It is closer to Sector 6 than to the rest of this profession and it is the segment BRSR Core is creating.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream.
Environmental science, engineering, commerce or economics. This profession recruits from all four and the commerce route is growing fastest because the work is reporting.
Optional but valued: BEE Certified Energy Auditor, GHG accounting certifications, or a sustainability master's.
A listed company's sustainability team, an accountancy or consulting firm's ESG practice, an assurance provider, or a rating agency.

entrance_exams.note: No gate specific to this profession. An MBA route is common on the consulting side, which is why CAT is named.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent sustainability and energy audit consultancy, which is a real market because BRSR Core requires third-party assurance and small companies need help preparing to be assured.

ai_exposure.reason: Substantially exposed, and it is worth being blunt because this profession is currently fashionable. ESG Reporting Specialist, Climate Disclosure Analyst and Carbon Accounting Analyst do work that is largely data collection, conversion against published emission factors, and narrative assembly to a template - which is close to a canonical automation target. What is protected is Energy Auditor and Green Building Consultant, because those require walking a site, and ESG Assurance Associate, because assurance requires a firm to put its name to an opinion.

nuances.statement: High, and unusually well explained by a single regulation. SEBI's BRSR made sustainability reporting mandatory for the top 1,000 listed companies from FY 2022-23, and BRSR Core extends third-party assurance to all of them by FY 2026-27. That is a compliance deadline creating jobs, which is a far more reliable demand signal than corporate enthusiasm.

The highest-paid profession in this sector is also among its most exposed, and those two facts are related: the work pays well because it is newly mandatory, and it is exposed because most of it is structured data assembly. A student entering it should aim at the assurance and audit end rather than the reporting end.

professions.one_liner: Gets solar and wind projects built and running - siting, resource, permits, performance.

deviating_roles.why: Resource and performance analysis is meteorology and statistics - predicting how much energy a site will yield over twenty years, which is what the project finance rests on. It is a desk discipline with no site presence.
Rooftop solar is a consumer sale - explaining subsidy, payback and net metering to a household or a housing society. It is the retail end and it is the largest employer in this profession.
Site engineering is construction supervision in remote locations with long postings - solar parks are built in Rajasthan and Gujarat deserts, not near cities.

path_to_entry.requirement: Physics and Mathematics for the engineering route; any stream for the commercial and consulting roles.
Electrical, mechanical or energy engineering, or an economics or commerce degree for the project finance and PPA side.
A developer, an EPC contractor, a consultancy, or a state renewable energy development agency.
Development, resource assessment, operations or offtake. These pay very differently and are hard to move between.

entrance_exams.note: No gate specific to renewable energy. Entry is through engineering or management in the ordinary way.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Rooftop solar installation and EPC on own account, which is a genuine small-business route with modest capital, or independent technical advisory to lenders and developers after a decade.

ai_exposure.reason: Moderate exposure concentrated on the analytical roles. Wind Resource Analyst, Solar Plant Performance Analyst and Battery Storage Analyst work on time-series modelling, which is directly automatable and already heavily software-mediated. Renewable Energy Site Engineer and Rooftop Solar Consultant are protected - one by being on a construction site in the desert, the other by having to persuade a housing society committee.

nuances.statement: High, and among the best-founded demand signals in this dataset because it rests on installed capacity targets and on projects with financing already closed - not on sentiment. The caveat is geographic: development and operations jobs are in Rajasthan, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.

Solar and wind ENGINEERING sits in Sector 2 - an electrical engineer is an electrical engineer, and Solar Panel Technician was merged into Electrician there on exactly that test. What is here is the project layer: siting, resource, permits, offtake and performance, where the object of concern is the energy transition rather than the machine.

professions.one_liner: Collects, sorts and disposes of what cities throw away, and keeps the sewers running.

deviating_roles.why: Owning and operating mechanised desludging or sweeping equipment on municipal contract. This is the route the NAMASTE scheme is explicitly designed to create, and it is the only path in this profession that leads out of manual work.
Facility operation is machinery, process and quality of output rather than collection. It is the formal, safer end of waste work and it has a technical skill ladder.

The most dangerous work in this dataset. Entry into confined spaces with toxic gas kills workers every year in India despite the practice being unlawful, and the deaths are recorded as hazardous cleaning rather than as manual scavenging.

path_to_entry.requirement: None. This work is entered without schooling and overwhelmingly by people from Scheduled Caste communities.
Profiling under the NAMASTE scheme for sewer and septic tank workers, which brings PPE, health insurance and training.
Urban local body, a private sanitation contractor, or informal waste picking. Most is contract or daily wage rather than municipal employment.
Capital subsidy under NAMASTE to become a sanitation entrepreneur operating mechanised equipment - the scheme's own stated objective, and the only documented route out.

entrance_exams.note: None.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Owning mechanised desludging or collection equipment and contracting to urban local bodies. This is what the NAMASTE scheme's capital support exists to fund, and it is the difference between doing this work and running it.

ai_exposure.reason: Almost unexposed by AI, and that is the least important thing about the risk in this profession. The technology that matters here is not artificial intelligence but MECHANISATION - suction desludging machines, sewer robots and material recovery equipment - which is policy's declared answer to the deaths and which would displace exactly the manual roles it protects. Sanitation Supervisor and Material Recovery Facility Operator are the roles that survive mechanisation.

nuances.statement: High and permanent - every city generates waste daily - but this is demand for labour under conditions the law has already declared unacceptable. The Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers Act 2013 bans manual handling of human excreta, and about 38,000 sewer and septic tank workers had been profiled under NAMASTE by September 2024 against a ministry estimate of around 100,000 in urban India.

Fails the compensation filter, and listing this profession is a deliberate decision rather than an oversight. It is one of the largest occupations in urban India, it is overwhelmingly done by Scheduled Caste workers on contract or daily wage, and leaving it out would let the taxonomy present Indian work as cleaner than it is. The record names the route out - mechanised sanitation entrepreneurship - because the scheme that funds it is the honest answer to the question a student would ask.

Sewer & Septic Tank Worker is listed and must be read with its role_spread entry. Entering a sewer or septic tank manually is unlawful and continues to kill workers in India each year. It is recorded so that the hazard is visible in the data, not because it is a career anyone should be routed toward.

admin_review.reason: Three things are owed. No sourced wage figure exists for Indian sanitation workers, municipal or contract. No figure exists for what a NAMASTE-supported sanitation entrepreneur earns, which is the only documented route out of manual work. And a presentation decision is needed that the schema cannot make: how a recommender should surface an occupation that is large, lawful in part, lethal in part, and caste-bound in practice - it should almost certainly never be RECOMMENDED, only described.

professions.one_liner: Plans for floods, cyclones, heat and earthquakes before they happen, and coordinates after.

deviating_roles.why: Response work is command and logistics under time pressure with incomplete information, often for weeks without rest. It is a completely different temperament from the analytical planning half of this profession.
Risk analysis is modelling and mapping done years before anything happens, for people who may never read it. The reward is invisible and the failure is catastrophic.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream.
Geography, geology, civil engineering, environmental science, planning or social work - all are routes in.
A master's in disaster management, climate science or urban planning; or entry through the development sector.
State or district disaster management authority, a municipal resilience cell, a humanitarian agency, or a consultancy advising cities and lenders on climate risk.

entrance_exams.note: Many senior disaster management posts in India are held by administrative service officers rather than by specialists, which is a real constraint on this as a technical career.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent climate risk and resilience advisory to cities, lenders and companies. Growing, because climate risk disclosure is becoming a financial requirement rather than a public-sector one.

ai_exposure.reason: Moderate exposure on the analytical half. Hazard Mapping Specialist and Early Warning Systems Analyst work with models and geospatial data that are increasingly automated, and forecasting itself is a machine learning success story. Emergency Operations Coordinator and Community Preparedness Trainer are protected entirely - coordinating a response and persuading a village to evacuate are things done by a person who is there.

nuances.statement: Moderate, and it is a profession whose need and whose funded posts are badly mismatched. India's exposure to flood, cyclone and extreme heat is rising and measurable; the number of specialist posts is small, and the senior ones are usually filled by generalist administrative officers rather than by specialists.

Pathway is 'any' because climate risk analysis has become a financial-sector skill internationally - lenders and insurers now require it - which gives this profession an unusual escape route from India's thin public-sector demand.

professions.one_liner: Grows crops on land they own, rent or work - the occupation most Indians still live from.

deviating_roles.why: Farm labour is paid by the day for someone else's crop, with no land, no decision and no exposure to the harvest. It is the largest single form of rural employment and the poorest, and the survey data shows it is now the biggest income source even for households that farm their own land.
Managing land for a company or under a buyback contract is agronomy plus record keeping against a specification. The risk shifts to the buyer and so does much of the decision-making.

Owning a tractor, harvester or drone and hiring it out across a village is a machinery business attached to farming. It is capital rather than land, and it is one of the few documented ways a small farmer raises income.
Certified organic and natural farming trades yield for price, requires certification and record-keeping, and takes three years of transition before the premium arrives.

path_to_entry.requirement: None. This occupation is entered by inheritance far more often than by choice.
Access to land - owned, inherited, leased or sharecropped. This, not a qualification, is the binding constraint.
Krishi Vigyan Kendra training, state extension programmes, or a B.Sc Agriculture. None is required and most farmers have none.
Join a Farmer Producer Organisation, take up custom hiring, or add livestock - the documented routes to a viable income from a small holding.

entrance_exams.note: Neither is required to farm. They are the route into agricultural EDUCATION, and ICAR fills only 15 percent of those seats.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Farming your own or leased land is self-employment by definition. What changes the income is not more land but a second engine: livestock, a Farmer Producer Organisation that aggregates and sells, custom hiring of machinery, or direct sale that skips the mandi.

ai_exposure.reason: Almost unexposed by AI, and that framing misses the point for this profession. The relevant technology is MECHANISATION and precision agriculture - drones, sensors, harvesters - which reduces the labour a hectare needs. That is good for a landowning farmer and bad for an Agricultural Labourer, who is the larger group. Advisory apps and image-based pest diagnosis substitute for extension advice rather than for the farmer.

nuances.statement: Verified, and it says something families are rarely told. An agricultural HOUSEHOLD earned Rs 10,218 a month in 2018-19 - about 1.23 lakh a year for a whole household - and only Rs 3,798 of it came from cultivation. Wages and salaries at Rs 4,063 are now the LARGER source. For most Indian farming families, farming is no longer the main source of the family's income.

Fails the compensation filter, and it is the largest occupation in the country. That is not an argument against the filter - the filter is telling the truth - but it is the sharpest illustration of why the application must be able to reverse it. A student from a farming family is not choosing whether farming pays; they are deciding what to do about a household that already lives on this.

High is the right value and it needs care in reading. It means the work exists at enormous scale and is not disappearing, not that entering it is a good financial decision. Roughly 45 percent of Indian workers are in agriculture producing about 18 percent of GDP, which is the whole problem in one ratio.

admin_review.reason: The verified figure is a HOUSEHOLD figure, not a personal income, and the schema has no way to say so - which risks a student reading 1.23 lakh as a salary. Two further gaps: no sourced figure for what a Farmer Producer Organisation membership or a custom hiring operation actually adds, which are the two documented routes upward, and no figure for agricultural labour daily wages, which is now the largest income source in farming households.

professions.one_liner: Works out how to grow more, better and with less - varieties, soil, pests, practice.

deviating_roles.why: Breeding a variety is a decade-long programme of crossing, selection and trials. It is the longest feedback loop in applied science and it is done inside ICAR institutes and state agricultural universities.

Advisory roles sit with agri-input companies and agritech firms, translating agronomy into a recommendation a farmer will act on - and often into a product sale, which is a real conflict a student should see.

path_to_entry.requirement: Physics, Chemistry and Biology; Agriculture as a subject where offered. Mathematics is accepted in place of Biology for some programmes.
State agricultural university counselling for most seats; CUET (ICAR-UG) for about 15 percent of them.
B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture, 4 years.
M.Sc in the specialisation. Effectively required for anything beyond field advisory work.
ICAR institute or state agricultural university via the ARS examination, a seed or agri-input company, or an agritech firm.

entrance_exams.note: The ARS examination is the decisive gate for a research career; the degree entrance is the ordinary one and is mostly a state process.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent agronomy advisory, seed production on contract, or a consultancy to agritech and input companies. It depends on a reputation among farmers, which takes a decade.

ai_exposure.reason: Low exposure, protected by biology and by place. A model can read a research paper; it cannot run a multi-season varietal trial, judge a soil by handling it, or know why a recommendation that works in Punjab fails in Vidarbha. Crop Advisory Specialist carries the most exposure - image-based pest and disease diagnosis is genuinely good and is already deployed in farmer apps - but that displaces the routine half of advisory rather than the agronomist.

nuances.statement: PCB is listed because it is the common requirement, but this is one of the few science professions where Mathematics is accepted in place of Biology at many universities, and where Agriculture is itself a class 12 subject in several state boards. A student should check the specific university rather than assume.

Moderate, and it splits sharply by employer. ICAR and state agricultural university posts are few and filled by examination; the growth is in private seed, agri-input and agritech companies, which pay better and offer no security.

CUET (ICAR-UG) is listed first but is NOT the ordinary way in. It fills only 15 percent of bachelor's seats at the roughly 74 participating agricultural universities; the other 85 percent go through state quotas and state counselling. Treating this national examination as THE gate would overstate how closed agricultural education is by nearly seven times. It is the clearest case in the taxonomy of a famous national exam that most entrants never sit. Source: data/verified_facts.json#icar-aieea-fifteen-percent.

professions.one_liner: Engineers the physical side of farming - machinery, irrigation, storage, processing.

deviating_roles.why: Servicing tractors, harvesters and pump sets is a skilled trade entered through an ITI rather than a degree. It is the largest employment inside this profession and it exists in every taluka.

Drone spraying and survey requires a DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate and is one of the genuinely new occupations in Indian agriculture. It is also a self-employment route - a drone and a licence is a business.

path_to_entry.requirement: Physics and Mathematics. Chemistry is NOT compulsory for the JEE route; agricultural university counselling may differ and should be checked against the specific university.
JEE Main, a state engineering entrance, or agricultural university counselling.
B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering, offered mainly at agricultural universities rather than at engineering colleges.
Farm machinery manufacturer, an irrigation company, a food processing firm, a state agriculture engineering department, or a custom hiring centre.

entrance_exams.note: This degree sits across two systems - some seats are filled through engineering entrances and some through agricultural university counselling, which confuses a lot of applicants.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: A custom hiring centre - owning machinery and hiring it out with an operator - or a micro-irrigation installation business. Both are the same insight: in Indian agriculture the money is in owning the equipment, not in operating someone else's.

ai_exposure.reason: Low exposure. Machinery has to be designed for real field conditions and then repaired in them, and Farm Equipment Service Technician is as safe as any trade in Sector 2. Micro-Irrigation Designer carries some exposure since layout design is increasingly software driven, and Agri-Drone Application Specialist is an occupation that automation CREATED rather than threatens.

nuances.statement: Moderate and rising for a specific reason: Indian farm labour is becoming scarcer and costlier as rural workers move to construction and services, which is pushing mechanisation on holdings that were previously too small to justify it. Custom hiring is how that reaches a two-hectare farm.

Farm Equipment Service Technician is deliberately inside this profession rather than left out as too junior. It is entered through an ITI, needs no degree, exists in every taluka, and is one of the few technical livelihoods genuinely available to a student who stays in a small town.

professions.one_liner: Turns crops into food that keeps, is safe to eat, and tastes the same every time.

deviating_roles.why: Food safety work is auditing against FSSAI standards and HACCP plans, with legal consequences for the company and sometimes for the named person. It is regulatory rather than developmental.
Development is formulation and tasting - inventing a product and proving people like it. Sensory analysis is a measurement discipline built on human panels.
Running a processing line is shift supervision of people and machinery under hygiene discipline. It is the entry job in most Indian food companies.

path_to_entry.requirement: Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Mathematics.
CUET, a state agricultural university process, or JEE Main for the B.Tech Food Technology route.
B.Tech or B.Sc in Food Technology, Food Science or Dairy Technology.
A food or dairy processing company, a quality and testing laboratory, a retail or restaurant chain's food safety team, or FSSAI-linked compliance work.

entrance_exams.note: Entry is an ordinary degree admission. FSSAI training and certification matter later, for the compliance roles rather than for entry.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Independent food safety consultancy and FSSAI licensing support for small manufacturers and restaurants, or a small processing unit. The consultancy route is real and growing because compliance obligations now reach very small businesses.

ai_exposure.reason: Low exposure, protected by physical product and by regulation. Food has to be made, tested and tasted, and somebody must sign the safety records. Sensory Analyst is the most exposed role on paper - preference modelling from panel data is statistics - but it is protected by needing human panels in the first place. Food Safety & Quality Manager is protected by carrying named responsibility under food law.

nuances.statement: Physics and Chemistry only, because listing Biology as well would wrongly shut out PCM students - Food Technology and B.Tech Food Engineering accept Mathematics in place of Biology at most universities. Over-restricting a subject gate is not a safe error in this dataset; it deletes a route a student actually has.

High, and among the more reliable demand signals in this dataset. It rests on two things that are both still expanding: India's shift from unpackaged to packaged food, and the extension of FSSAI licensing and hygiene obligations down to very small businesses. Both create work that did not exist a decade ago.

Promised here from Sector 3 rather than kept with the sciences. The method is applied chemistry and microbiology, but the object of concern is food - getting it from a field into a person safely - which is this sector.

professions.one_liner: Keeps animals productive and healthy - milk, poultry, goats, and the systems around them.

deviating_roles.why: These are technical animal-handling roles - inseminating, vaccinating, treating minor conditions - performed in villages where no veterinarian will come. They are trained, certified and the closest thing to primary animal healthcare most of rural India has.

Procurement runs the collection network for a dairy cooperative or private dairy - testing, pricing, payments and farmer relationships across dozens of villages. It is the commercial job inside a livestock profession.
Commercial poultry is the most industrialised animal production in India - batch cycles, feed conversion ratios, biosecurity and very thin margins. It is closer to factory management than to farming.

path_to_entry.requirement: None for the farm and technician routes; PCB for a B.Sc or B.V.Sc route.
A dairy or livestock diploma, an artificial insemination or para-vet certification, or a Krishi Vigyan Kendra course. Many enter with family experience and no certificate.
Own herd, a dairy cooperative, a private dairy, a commercial poultry or feed company, or the state animal husbandry department.
Grow the herd, or move into procurement, extension or feed - the routes that convert animal work into a salary.

entrance_exams.note: There is no entrance examination for the farm and technician routes. Veterinary practice is a different profession entirely and requires NEET and a B.V.Sc.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Owning animals is the profession for most people in it. A dairy herd of ten crossbred cows supplying a cooperative is a different economic proposition from working on someone else's farm, and it is the standard aspiration.

ai_exposure.reason: Almost unexposed. Animals are handled, fed, milked and treated by people, in sheds, twice a day, every day. Milk Procurement Officer carries the only real exposure through automated testing and digital payment systems at collection centres, which has already changed that role substantially without removing it.

nuances.statement: Livestock contributed Rs 1,582 of an agricultural household's Rs 10,218 monthly income in 2018-19 - about 15 percent - and it is the most reliable component because milk sells daily while a crop sells twice a year. That daily cashflow, not the annual total, is why dairy matters to a small farming household.

High, and India is the world's largest milk producer, but demand here means demand for OUTPUT rather than for salaried posts. Most of this profession is self-employment on a small herd; the salaried roles are in cooperatives, private dairies and feed companies and are far fewer.

admin_review.reason: No sourced figure for what a small dairy herd actually earns net of feed, which is the calculation every entrant to this profession is really making, and none for artificial insemination or para-vet technician incomes. The livestock share of household income is sourced; the unit economics of the herd are not.

professions.one_liner: Grows fruit, vegetables, flowers, tea and spices - the high-value, high-risk end of farming.

deviating_roles.why: Tea, coffee and rubber estates are labour-managing jobs - hundreds of workers, housing, welfare and a colonial-era employment structure. It is people management in a remote location, not horticulture.
Polyhouse and hydroponic growing is climate control, nutrient dosing and pest management as an engineering problem. Capital cost is high, and it is the most technical growing in Indian agriculture.
Landscaping serves clients and aesthetics rather than yield. It is an urban service livelihood attached to a rural profession and it pays more reliably than growing.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream for the practical routes; PCB for a B.Sc Horticulture.
B.Sc Horticulture, a diploma, or a Krishi Vigyan Kendra course. Many growers have none of these.
Own orchard or polyhouse, a plantation company, a nursery, an export packhouse, or a landscaping firm.
Secure a buyer before you plant. In horticulture the market, not the crop, is what fails.

entrance_exams.note: Not required for the practical routes, which is how most horticulture in India is entered.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Growing high-value crops on own or leased land and selling direct - to an exporter, a retail chain, or through a Farmer Producer Organisation. Horticulture is where direct marketing actually changes the economics, because the produce is worth enough to justify the effort.

ai_exposure.reason: Almost unexposed. Growing, pruning, harvesting and grading are physical work on living plants in a field or a polyhouse. Protected Cultivation & Greenhouse Manager carries a little exposure through automated climate and irrigation control, which is a tool the manager uses rather than a substitute for them.

nuances.statement: Moderate, and the risk profile is the opposite of staple farming. Horticulture returns several times more per hectare and has no minimum support price, no procurement and very little storage - so a price crash or a delayed truck destroys a season. Higher ceiling, no floor.

The range understates the upside and hides the variance. A polyhouse of capsicum or a well-marketed orchard can earn many times the figures shown; a season with no buyer earns nothing and the input cost is already spent.

admin_review.reason: No sourced figures for horticulture returns per acre or for plantation sector wages, and the second matters: tea and coffee estate wages are set by state plantation labour rules and are published, which makes them fetchable and would anchor this record the way the NSS survey anchors Farmer.

professions.one_liner: Catches or farms fish and shrimp - marine, inland and pond, and the cold chain behind it.

deviating_roles.why: Marine capture fishing is among the most dangerous occupations in India - long voyages, weather, debt to boat owners and a catch that may not come. It is traditional, community-based and almost entirely informal.

Aquaculture is water chemistry, feed management and disease control on a capital-intensive pond. Shrimp in particular is a high-margin, high-risk export business where one disease outbreak wipes out a crop.
A state fisheries department post is extension, licensing and scheme delivery - a government job attached to the sector rather than work on the water.

path_to_entry.requirement: None for capture fishing and farm work; PCB for a B.F.Sc.
B.F.Sc (4 years) for the professional and government routes; on-the-job or a short course for pond and hatchery work.
Own or crew a boat, an aquaculture farm, a hatchery, a processing and export unit, or a state fisheries department.
Own ponds or a hatchery. In aquaculture the returns and the risk both sit with whoever owns the water.

entrance_exams.note: B.F.Sc admission runs through agricultural university systems. Nothing is required to fish.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Owning ponds, a hatchery or a boat. Aquaculture is one of the higher-return self-employment routes in Indian agriculture and also one of the riskiest - a shrimp crop can fail completely.

ai_exposure.reason: Almost unexposed. Fishing, pond management and hatchery work are physical, outdoor and biological. Aquatic Health Specialist and Aquaculture Farm Manager use sensing and water quality monitoring that is increasingly automated, which improves the work rather than replacing the person standing at the pond edge deciding whether to harvest early.

nuances.statement: Moderate and export-linked, which is the risk. Indian shrimp aquaculture is built on a small number of export markets and their sanitary and anti-dumping decisions; a single trade action can collapse prices for a season. Inland fish for the domestic market is far steadier and far less profitable.

Fisherman is included as the base layer and should be read with its role_spread entry. Marine capture fishing is among the most dangerous occupations in the country, is largely informal, and is frequently financed by debt to a boat owner - a structure that determines the income more than the catch does.

admin_review.reason: No sourced income figures for Indian capture fishing or for aquaculture returns per hectare, and the two are entirely different economies wrongly sharing one record's numbers. Fishermen's earnings in particular are shaped by boat-owner debt arrangements that no salary range can express.

professions.one_liner: Connects farmers to knowledge, inputs, credit and buyers - the business side of farming.

deviating_roles.why: Agricultural lending is credit appraisal against land, crop and weather risk, done for a bank or an NBFC. It is a banking job that requires agronomy, and it pays like banking rather than like agriculture.

Input dealers sell seed, fertiliser and pesticide, extend informal credit, and are in practice the main source of agronomic advice for most Indian farmers. That the adviser is also the seller is the sector's oldest conflict of interest.

Running an FPO is aggregating produce from hundreds of small farmers and negotiating with buyers on their behalf. It is a cooperative business role and it is the policy-favoured answer to small holdings.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream for the business roles; PCB or agriculture for extension posts.
B.Sc Agriculture for extension and technical roles; any degree, or an agri-business MBA, for the commercial ones.
State agriculture department, a Krishi Vigyan Kendra, an input or seed company, a bank's agriculture desk, an agritech firm, or an FPO.
An input dealership or a procurement and trading business - the two commonest ways people in this profession end up working for themselves.

private_entrances: Agri-business management entrances (IIM Ahmedabad PGP-FABM, IRMA)
entrance_exams.note: There is no single gate. Government extension posts go through state recruitment, banking roles through IBPS, and agri-business management through CAT or the specialist entrances.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: An agri-input dealership, a procurement or trading business, or independent advisory to FPOs and agritech firms. The dealership is the classic route and it is a retail business with a credit book attached.

ai_exposure.reason: Moderately exposed, and the exposure lands on the sector's most valuable function. Extension advice - which variety, when to sow, what this leaf spot is - is exactly what farmer advisory apps and image diagnosis now do at zero marginal cost, and Agritech Field Executive and much of Agricultural Extension Officer work is directly substitutable. What survives is where money and trust change hands: Rural Credit & Agri-Finance Officer, Agri-Input Dealer and Farmer Producer Organisation Manager all depend on knowing a specific farmer well enough to lend to them or sell for them.

nuances.statement: Null. IBPS PO is named in entrance_exams because banks recruit Agriculture Field Officers and it is a genuine well-paid route - but making it the primary_gate would say the way to become an agri-business professional is to pass a banking examination, which is false for almost everyone in this profession.

High, and it is the part of this sector where salaried jobs actually are. Agriculture employs about 45 percent of Indian workers but almost none of them are employees; the agri-input, agri-finance, agritech and FPO layer is where a graduate finds a salary in this sector.

Agri-Input Dealer is listed with its conflict of interest stated in the role_spread rather than hidden. In most of rural India the person selling the pesticide is also the person advising on whether it is needed, and a student entering this profession should understand that they are entering that position.

professions.one_liner: Cooks for a living at scale - hotels, restaurants, canteens, cloud kitchens, ships.

deviating_roles.why: Baking is chemistry with no room for adjustment - weights, temperatures and timing fixed in advance. It runs on a different shift from the kitchen and suits a different temperament from service cooking.

Cooking for a hostel, a hospital, a factory canteen or a household is volume and consistency to a budget, with no menu creativity and no recognition. It is the largest employment in this profession by a wide margin and the least visible.
Delivery-only kitchens are high-throughput assembly against app timers, with no dining room and no customer contact. The work is speed and packaging discipline rather than craft.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream, or none. Craft courses take class 10 pass; the B.Sc route needs class 12.
An IHM craft course or diploma, a B.Sc Hospitality and Hotel Administration, or a kitchen apprenticeship with no certificate at all - all three are normal.
Commis in a hotel or restaurant kitchen. Entry pay is low and hours are long; this is the profession's known filter.
A section - garde manger, butchery, bakery, Indian, continental. Specialising is what moves a cook off the entry wage.

entrance_exams.note: Neither is required to cook professionally. NCHMCT JEE is the route into the degree, and a large share of working Indian chefs never sat it.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Own restaurant, cloud kitchen, catering business or tiffin service. Catering and cloud kitchens need far less capital than a restaurant and are the realistic first step; this is also where almost all the money in the profession is.

ai_exposure.reason: Almost unexposed. Cooking is heat, hands, timing and taste in a physical kitchen, and no part of it is a text or image problem. Recipe generation touches menu development, which is a small slice of one senior role. The real technological pressure on this profession is different and worth naming: cloud kitchens and central production units are deskilling the line, turning cooks into assemblers of components made elsewhere.

nuances.statement: The wide mid-career range is a real spread, not uncertainty. A hotel kitchen in a metro, a cruise line contract and a small-town restaurant pay very differently for the same skill, and the overseas route - cruise ships, the Gulf, hotel chains abroad - is why pathway is 'any' and is how many Indian chefs actually raise their income.

High and among the most geographically distributed in this dataset. Every town has kitchens. That makes it one of very few skilled livelihoods genuinely available to a student who does not move to a city.

Null, and it was wrong on the first pass. NCHMCT JEE was named as primary because it is the only quantified door in this sector - but this record's own entrance_exams note says most working Indian chefs never sat it, and both statements could not be true. Cooking is entered through a kitchen. The gate stays on Hotel & Restaurant Manager, where the IHM degree really is the main route.

professions.one_liner: Serves guests food and drink and runs the room - restaurants, bars, banquets, trains, air.

deviating_roles.why: Beverage specialisms carry a knowledge base - spirits, cocktails, wine regions and food pairing - that the rest of service does not. Both are also the roles where a personal following genuinely raises earnings.
Banquet and quick-service work is high-volume, standardised and frequently casual or per-shift. It is how most people enter this profession and it teaches little that transfers upward.
Running a section means reading tables, handling complaints and directing staff during a service that cannot be paused. It is the first role with real judgment in it.

path_to_entry.requirement: None for most service roles; class 12 for hotel management programmes.
An IHM or private hospitality course, a THSC-aligned certification, or straight on-the-job training. Most enter with the last.
Restaurant, hotel, cafe chain, catering company, railway or airline catering, or a cruise line.
Bar, wine, or supervision. Beverage specialisation is the clearest way to raise earnings inside service.

entrance_exams.note: Not required. Service is one of the most open occupations in India and hires largely on presentation and attitude.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: A cafe, bar or small restaurant of your own, or a catering and bartending service for events. Bartending in particular is a genuine freelance market at weddings and parties.

ai_exposure.reason: Low AI exposure and high exposure to something else. Ordering has already moved to apps and QR menus, and Cafe & QSR Service Crew and Room Service Attendant are the roles that shrinks - but that is self-service automation, not AI. What holds is hospitality itself: reading a table, fixing a complaint, and making a guest feel looked after. Sommelier and Bartender are protected further by knowledge and personality being the product.

nuances.statement: Fails nothing on the filter but sits low, and the record should be read with tips and service charge in mind - neither is captured here and both are material in hotels and premium restaurants. The overseas route, especially cruise lines and the Gulf, is again where earnings change.
High and permanently entry-friendly. This profession, along with retail in Sector 5, is one of the main places an Indian school-leaver with no qualification actually finds formal-sector work.

admin_review.reason: No sourced wage figure for Indian hospitality service staff, and the record cannot show tips, service charge or the overseas premium - which between them are much of the real income. Cruise line and Gulf contract pay in particular is the difference between this being a low-wage job and a genuine earner, and no figure for it was found.

professions.one_liner: Keeps rooms, buildings and linen clean and ready - hotels, hospitals, offices, homestays.

deviating_roles.why: Hospital housekeeping is infection control - biomedical waste segregation, disinfection protocols and isolation procedure. It carries clinical risk that hotel housekeeping does not and it is trained and audited differently.
Supervision is rosters, inventory, contract staff and inspection standards. It is the step off the floor and it is the only reliable progression in this profession.

path_to_entry.requirement: None. Class 8 or 10 is typical.
On-the-job, or a short THSC-aligned housekeeping certification. Hospital housekeeping requires infection-control training.
Hotel, hospital, facility management contractor, corporate office or serviced apartment. Most of it is contract employment through an agency rather than direct.
Supervisor, then executive. Or run a homestay or a small housekeeping contract of your own.

entrance_exams.note: None.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: A small housekeeping or facility services contract - a team, supplies and a client. It is a low-capital services business and it is how supervisors in this trade raise their income.

ai_exposure.reason: Effectively unexposed to AI, and this is another case where naming AI is the wrong risk. Cleaning a room is physical work in an unstructured space. The technology that matters is mechanised cleaning equipment, which raises output per worker rather than replacing the worker, and scheduling software, which has already changed how contract housekeeping is managed.

nuances.statement: Fails the compensation filter, and it is one of the largest formal-sector entry occupations available to Indian women without qualifications. Almost all of it is CONTRACT employment through a facility management agency rather than direct employment by the hotel or hospital, which determines pay, benefits and job security more than the employer's name does.

High and growing with organised retail, hospitals, offices and hotels. It is also one of the few occupations in this dataset where formalisation is genuinely increasing - facility management contracting has moved a large amount of this work from informal to at least nominally formal employment.

admin_review.reason: No sourced wage figure for Indian housekeeping staff, and the more important missing distinction is between direct hotel employment and agency contract employment, which is where pay, provident fund and security actually differ. No figure either for what a small housekeeping contract earns, which is the named route up.

professions.one_liner: Runs the place - rooms, covers, staff, cost, and what happens when a guest is unhappy.

deviating_roles.why: Revenue management is pricing and inventory analytics - deciding what a room should cost tonight across a dozen booking channels. It is a quantitative desk job inside a hospitality profession and it transfers to airline and travel pricing.

The desk is the hotel's face - check-in, complaints, and the person a guest asks for when something is wrong. It runs on shifts including nights and it is the standard entry role for a hotel management graduate.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream.
NCHMCT JEE for the Institutes of Hotel Management, or a state or private institute admission.
B.Sc Hospitality and Hotel Administration (3 years), or any degree plus hotel experience.
Management trainee or front office executive, then a section. Progression is by rotating through departments.

entrance_exams.note: NCHMCT JEE is the main national route and it is not restrictive - over 12,000 seats across about 80 institutes.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Own restaurant, homestay, boutique hotel or cloud kitchen brand. Very common in this profession, and the operational knowledge transfers directly - which is why hospitality graduates start businesses at a higher rate than most.

ai_exposure.reason: Moderately exposed on the desk and protected on the floor. Revenue & Reservations Executive is the most exposed role - dynamic pricing is already algorithmic and improving - and routine reservations and enquiry handling have largely moved to booking platforms and chat. Duty Manager, Front Office Executive and Restaurant Manager are protected by being the person physically accountable when something goes wrong at eleven at night.

nuances.statement: Null. NCHMCT JEE was recorded here on the first pass and removed on review: this record is mid_stream_entry 'after_any_degree', its own path_to_entry says 'any degree plus hotel experience', and the exam offers over 12,000 seats. A gate that admits any graduate and is not scarce is not the thing that determines who reaches the profession.

The employed range is Indian. The profession's real economics for many people are overseas - Gulf hotels, cruise lines and international chains - and that pathway is a large part of why students choose hotel management. It is why pathway is 'any' and it is not visible in these numbers.

High, and unusually resilient in a specific way: hospitality collapsed completely during the pandemic and rebuilt, and the sector's hiring now runs ahead of the supply of trained people because a cohort left the industry and did not return.

professions.one_liner: Plans, sells and guides travel - itineraries, tickets, tours and the people on them.

deviating_roles.why: Guiding is performance and knowledge on foot, in a language the visitor speaks. Regional-language and foreign-language guides are licensed by the Ministry of Tourism at monument level, which is the only credential in this profession.
Ticketing is systems work against fare rules and policy. It was the industry's largest entry job and it is the one online booking has most comprehensively taken.
Escorting a group for two weeks means being responsible for thirty strangers, their luggage, their illnesses and their complaints, away from home. It is logistics under continuous social pressure.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream. A second language is worth more than a stream in this profession.
BA or diploma in Travel and Tourism, an IATA-recognised course for ticketing, or a Ministry of Tourism guide training programme.
For guiding at protected monuments, a Ministry of Tourism or state tourism department guide licence.
Travel agency, tour operator, online travel platform, a hotel's travel desk, or independent guiding.

public_routes: Ministry of Tourism regional guide training and licensing
entrance_exams.note: Guide licensing is the only real credential and it is monument- and region-specific. Everything else in this profession is entered without an examination.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: An independent tour operation, a niche travel business - wildlife, pilgrimage, adventure, weddings abroad - or freelance guiding. Low capital and high dependence on repeat customers and reviews.

ai_exposure.reason: The most AI-exposed profession in this sector, and the damage arrived before AI did. Ticketing & Reservations Executive and Travel Consultant lost their market to online booking over two decades, and language models finish the job on itinerary planning and destination advice - both are high-retrievable-knowledge tasks. What survives is physical presence and accountability: Tour Guide, licensed and standing in front of the monument, and Tour Manager, responsible for thirty people in a foreign country when something goes wrong.

nuances.statement: Moderate, and the composition has changed completely rather than the level. Indian domestic and outbound travel volumes are at record highs while the number of people employed selling travel has fallen - the value moved to platforms. Growth is in experiences and guiding, not in agency work.

Null at profession level, but guiding at protected monuments does require a Ministry of Tourism or state licence. It is a permission to work at specific sites rather than a professional register, which is why the field stays null.

professions.one_liner: Makes an event happen - weddings, conferences, concerts, exhibitions, sport.

deviating_roles.why: Indian weddings are the largest single event market in the country and the most emotionally loaded. The planner manages two families, a budget nobody will state honestly, and an event that cannot be rescheduled.
These are sales roles inside events - finding the money rather than spending it. They carry targets and commission and sit closer to Sector 5's Sales Professional.
Production is load-in, power, staging, permissions and safety, executed overnight to a fixed doors-open time. It is the operational half and it is where events actually fail.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream.
Any bachelor's degree; event management, hospitality and mass communication are common. None is required.
Event company, a hotel's banquet team, a wedding planning firm, an exhibition organiser, or a brand's activation team. Entry is usually as a coordinator on live events.
Own event or wedding planning business - the standard destination, and one that needs relationships with vendors more than capital.

entrance_exams.note: None. Entry is on executed events, not on an examination.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

self_employment.route: Own event or wedding planning business. Extremely common in this profession, needs little capital, and runs on a vendor network and referrals rather than on marketing.

ai_exposure.reason: Low to moderate exposure. Planning documents, run sheets, budgets and vendor briefs generate well, and Conference & MICE Executive work is the most exposed. But an event is a physical thing that happens once at a fixed time, and Production Coordinator (Events) and Venue Operations Executive are protected absolutely by that. Wedding Planner is protected by managing two families through the most emotionally loaded purchase of their lives, which no model is going to be trusted with.

nuances.statement: Promised here from Sector 5, and the placement is arguable in the other direction. An event company is a business and event management is project management - but the object of concern is a HOSTED EXPERIENCE for guests, which is what this sector is about, and event management in India sits inside hospitality commercially, in hotels and banquet venues.

High, and it rests substantially on the Indian wedding market rather than on corporate events. That makes the work seasonal, family-facing and spread across smaller cities rather than concentrated in metros.

professions.one_liner: Keeps an aircraft cabin safe and its passengers looked after - a safety job that serves food.

deviating_roles.why: Training is classroom and simulator instruction on safety and emergency procedure, against a DGCA-approved syllabus. It is the standard route off the roster and out of shift work.

Ground handling is check-in, boarding and disruption management at the airport. It shares the airline and the customer but none of the safety role, and it is often the fallback for people who do not clear cabin crew medicals.

path_to_entry.requirement: Class 12 in any stream. English fluency is required and a second language helps.
Airline height, reach, weight and medical criteria, including vision and swimming. These are absolute and screen out a large number of applicants before anything else is assessed.
Airline assessment day - group activity, personal interview, grooming and communication. Not an examination and not published.
Airline ab-initio training against a DGCA-approved syllabus, ending in a Cabin Crew Member certification. Safety and emergency procedure is the bulk of it.

entrance_exams.note: There is no entrance examination. Selection is by airline assessment against physical and communication criteria, and PRIVATE AVIATION ACADEMIES SELLING PLACEMENT ARE NOT A ROUTE - airlines recruit and train directly.

entry_window.constrained_route: Most Indian airlines set an upper age of about 27 for ab-initio cabin crew recruitment, and physical criteria including height and reach are applied absolutely.
entry_window.bypass: Experienced crew are recruited at higher ages, and ground services, airport operations and in-flight training roles have no such limit. The age bar applies to first entry, not to the industry.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years of EMPLOYMENT after entering the field, EMPLOYED only. Independent practice and business ownership are excluded - that income is entrepreneurship, and self_employment carries it separately.

ai_exposure.reason: Low exposure, and the reason is the one most people get wrong about this job. It looks like service work; it is legally a SAFETY role. Cabin crew are on board because regulation requires trained humans to evacuate an aircraft in ninety seconds, and no amount of automation changes that requirement. The service element could be reduced; the safety minimum cannot.

nuances.statement: The only meaningful age window in this sector and it is real. Indian airlines recruit ab-initio cabin crew up to roughly 27, and the physical criteria - height, reach, vision, swimming - are applied absolutely. It is not a hard block because the wider industry has no such limit, but for THIS entry it closes early and a student should plan on that.

Rare, and correctly so - this work exists only inside a certificated airline. Any offer of independent cabin crew work should be treated as a warning sign, and so should any academy charging for a course that promises placement.

Indian carrier pay is modest at entry and rises with flying hours and allowances rather than with a salary scale. The Gulf carriers pay substantially more with accommodation provided, which is why pathway is 'any' and why a large number of Indian cabin crew work abroad.

professions.one_liner: Finds and reads the physical remains of the past - excavation, survey, dating, publication.

deviating_roles.why: Reading inscriptions and coins requires classical languages and scripts - Brahmi, Sanskrit, Persian, Tamil - held in memory. It is desk and museum work and it is where much of Indian archaeology's actual evidence is produced.
Analysing seeds, pollen and animal bone from a site is laboratory science attached to a humanities discipline, and it is closer in method to Sector 3 than to the rest of this profession.

Field archaeology is months in a trench in the dry season, managing labour, recording stratigraphy and living on site. It is physically demanding outdoor work that the public image of the profession does not convey.

path_to_entry.requirement: Any stream. Arts is the usual route and science backgrounds are valued for the analytical specialisms.
